entries.name: tlsf_fli
entries.statement: tlsf_fli((s : W32)) == word_sub(word(31), int_clz(s))

entries.name: tlsf_sli
entries.statement:
tlsf_sli((s : W32), (f : W32))
  == word_and(word_jushr(s, word_sub(f, word(4))), word(15))

entries.name: tlsf_mask
entries.statement:
tlsf_mask((s : W32))
  == word_sub(word_jshl(word(1), word_sub(tlsf_fli(s), word(4))), word(1))

entries.name: tlsf_round
entries.statement:
tlsf_round((s : W32))
  == word_and(word_add(s, tlsf_mask(s)), word_not(tlsf_mask(s)))

entries.name: tlsf_exp_lt
entries.statement: ∀ (m n : Num), (EXP(2, m) < EXP(2, n)) == (m < n)

entries.name: tlsf_fli_clz
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. !(s == word(0))
then
  val(tlsf_fli(s)) == 31 - word_clz(s)

entries.name: tlsf_fli_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. !(s == word(0))
then
  val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s))) <= val(s)
  && val(s) < EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) + 1)

entries.name: tlsf_fli_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32) (f : Num)
if
  1. EXP(2, f) <= val(s)
  2. val(s) < EXP(2, f + 1)
then
  val(tlsf_fli(s)) == f

entries.name: tlsf_sli_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  4 <= val(tlsf_fli(s))
  && val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))
       == MOD(DIV(val(s), EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)), 16)

entries.name: tlsf_class_num
entries.statement:
∀ (v k : Num)
if
  1. EXP(2, k + 4) <= v
  2. v < EXP(2, k + 5)
then
  16 <= DIV(v, EXP(2, k))
  && DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) < 32
  && MOD(DIV(v, EXP(2, k)), 16) == DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) - 16
  && DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) * EXP(2, k) <= v
  && v < DIV(v, EXP(2, k)) * EXP(2, k) + EXP(2, k)

entries.name: tlsf_class
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  4 <= val(tlsf_fli(s))
  && val(tlsf_fli(s)) <= 31
  && val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s))) < 16
  && (16 + val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))) * EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) <= val(
       s)
  && val(s) < (17 + val(tlsf_sli(s, tlsf_fli(s)))) * EXP(
       2,
       val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)

entries.name: tlsf_mask_word
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
then
  tlsf_mask(s) == word(EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) - 1)

entries.name: tlsf_round_val
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
then
  val(tlsf_round(s)) == EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) * DIV(
    val(s) + (EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4) - 1),
    EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4))

entries.name: tlsf_class_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
  2. MOD(val(x), EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(x)) - 4)) == 0
then
  (16 + val(tlsf_sli(x, tlsf_fli(x)))) * EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(x)) - 4) == val(x)

entries.name: tlsf_round_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
then
  val(s) <= val(tlsf_round(s))
  && val(tlsf_round(s)) < val(s) + EXP(2, val(tlsf_fli(s)) - 4)
  && (16 + val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_round(s), tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))))) * EXP(
       2,
       val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))) - 4)
       == val(tlsf_round(s))

entries.name: tlsf_find_sound
entries.statement:
∀ (s t : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(s)
  2. val(s) <= 4160749568
  3. 16 <= val(t)
  4. val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s))) < val(tlsf_fli(t))
     || val(tlsf_fli(t)) == val(tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s)))
        && val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_round(s), tlsf_fli(tlsf_round(s)))) <= val(
             tlsf_sli(t, tlsf_fli(t)))
then
  val(s) <= val(t)

entries.name: tlsf_class_mono
entries.statement:
∀ (x y : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
  2. val(x) <= val(y)
then
  val(tlsf_fli(x)) < val(tlsf_fli(y))
or
  val(tlsf_fli(y)) == val(tlsf_fli(x))
  && val(tlsf_sli(x, tlsf_fli(x))) <= val(tlsf_sli(y, tlsf_fli(y)))

entries.name: TLSF free lists: push and pop (tlsf.mbt)
tlsf_code_fli
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32),
  word_sub(word(27), word(word_clz(x))) == word_sub(tlsf_fli(x), word(4))

entries.name: tlsf_code_sli
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32),
  word_and(word_jushr(x, word_sub(word(27), word(word_clz(x)))), word(15))
    == tlsf_sli(x, tlsf_fli(x))

entries.name: star_pure_hr

∀ (c : Bool) (p q : HProp),

entries.name: star_pure_hl

entries.name: star_ex_hr

  star(p, (h : Heap) => ∃ x : A, qq(x, h))
    == ((h : Heap) => ∃ x : A, star(p, qq(x), h))

entries.name: star_ex_hl

  star((h : Heap) => ∃ x : A, pp(x, h), q)
    == ((h : Heap) => ∃ x : A, star(pp(x), q, h))

entries.name: star_emp_hr

entries.name: star_emp_hl
entries.statement: ∀ (p : HProp), star(emp, p) == p

entries.name: sl_pure

  1. c → sl_triple(p, bs, q)

    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      c && p(vs, lc, gs, ms, h),
    bs,
    q)

entries.name: sl_ex

  (bs : List[B_e]) (q : SAssn)

  sl_triple(
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ x : A, pp(x, vs, lc, gs, ms, h),
    bs,
    q)

entries.name: tlsf_sync
entries.statement:
tlsf_sync((s : W32), (n : Num), (ne : (Num) -> Bool))
  == (∀ k : Num, bit(k, s) == (k < n && ne(k)))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_set
entries.statement:
∀ (s j : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. val(j) < n
  2. n <= 32
  3. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
then
  tlsf_sync(
    word_or(s, word_jshl(word(1), j)),
    n,
    (k : Num) => k == val(j) || ne(k))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_clear
entries.statement:
∀ (s j : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. val(j) < n
  2. n <= 32
  3. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
  4. ne(val(j))
then
  tlsf_sync(
    word_xor(s, word_jshl(word(1), j)),
    n,
    (k : Num) => !(k == val(j)) && ne(k))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_zero
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
then
  (s == word(0)) == (∀ k : Num, k < n → !ne(k))

entries.name: tlsf_code_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (x : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(x)
then
  val(word_and(word_jushr(x, word_sub(word(27), word(word_clz(x)))), word(15))) < 16
  && (val : (W32) -> Num)(
       (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
         (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
         (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(x)))) < 28

entries.name: tlsf_istar
entries.statement:
tlsf_istar((ff : (Num, Heap) -> Bool), 0) == emp
&& tlsf_istar((ff : (Num, Heap) -> Bool), SUC((n : Num)))
     == star(tlsf_istar(ff, n), ff(n))

entries.name: tlsf_istar_cong
entries.statement:
∀ (n : Num) (ff gg : (Num, Heap) -> Bool)
if
  1. ∀ i : Num, i < n → ff(i) == gg(i)
then
  tlsf_istar(ff, n) == tlsf_istar(gg, n)

entries.name: tlsf_istar_focus
entries.statement:
∀ (n k : Num) (ff : (Num, Heap) -> Bool)
if
  1. k < n
then
  tlsf_istar(ff, n)
    == star(ff(k), tlsf_istar((i : Num) => if i == k { emp } else { ff(i) }, n))

entries.name: tlsf_upd
entries.statement:
tlsf_upd((ff : (Num) -> A), (k : Num), (v : A))
  == ((i : Num) => if i == k { v } else { ff(i) })

entries.name: tlsf_slot_item
entries.statement:
tlsf_slot_item((d : W32), (fw : W32), (j : Num), (xs : List[W32])) == star(
  pts(
    val(
      word_add(
        word_add(
          word_add(
            word_add(
              word_and(word_add(d, word(15)), word(4294967280)),
              word(4)),
            word_mul(fw, word(68))),
          word(4)),
        word_jshl(word(j), word(2)))),
    serialise_i32(tlsf_hd(xs))),
  tlsf_bin(xs))

entries.name: tlsf_level
entries.statement:
tlsf_level((d : W32), (f : Num), (s : W32), (L : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_sync(s, 16, (j : Num) => !(L(j) == NIL))
    && star(
         pts(
           val(
             word_add(
               word_add(
                 word_and(word_add(d, word(15)), word(4294967280)),
                 word(4)),
               word_mul(word(f), word(68)))),
           serialise_i32(s)),
         tlsf_istar((j : Num) => tlsf_slot_item(d, word(f), j, L(j)), 16),
         h))

entries.name: tlsf_bins
entries.statement:
tlsf_bins(
  (d : W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_sync(fl, 28, (f : Num) => !(sb(f) == word(0)))
    && star(
         pts(
           val(word_and(word_add(d, word(15)), word(4294967280))),
           serialise_i32(fl)),
         tlsf_istar((f : Num) => tlsf_level(d, f, sb(f), bl(f)), 28),
         h))

entries.name: tlsf_upd_same
entries.statement: ∀ (ff : (Num) -> A) (k : Num) (v : A), tlsf_upd(ff, k, v, k) == v

entries.name: tlsf_level_rest
entries.statement:
∀ (d v : W32) (k : Num) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (L : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (
    (i : Num) =>
      if i == k { emp } else {
        tlsf_level(d, i, tlsf_upd(sb, k, v, i), tlsf_upd(bl, k, L, i)) })
    == ((i : Num) => if i == k { emp } else { tlsf_level(d, i, sb(i), bl(i)) })

entries.name: tlsf_item_rest
entries.statement:
∀ (d fw : W32) (k : Num) (L : (Num) -> List[W32]) (xs : List[W32]),
  (
    (j : Num) =>
      if j
        == k { emp } else { tlsf_slot_item(d, fw, j, tlsf_upd(L, k, xs, j)) })
    == ((j : Num) => if j == k { emp } else { tlsf_slot_item(d, fw, j, L(j)) })

entries.name: tlsf_or_bit_nz
entries.statement: ∀ (x j : W32), !(word_or(x, word_jshl(word(1), j)) == word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_push_bin
entries.statement:
∀ (s j m : W32) (L : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. val(j) < 16
  2. tlsf_sync(s, 16, (i : Num) => !(L(i) == NIL))
then
  tlsf_sync(
    word_or(s, word_jshl(word(1), j)),
    16,
    (i : Num) => !(tlsf_upd(L, val(j), CONS(m, L(val(j))), i) == NIL))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_push_top
entries.statement:
∀ (fl f j : W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
if
  1. val(f) < 28
  2. tlsf_sync(fl, 28, (i : Num) => !(sb(i) == word(0)))
then
  tlsf_sync(
    word_or(fl, word_jshl(word(1), f)),
    28,
    (i : Num) =>
      !(
        tlsf_upd(sb, val(f), word_or(sb(val(f)), word_jshl(word(1), j)), i)
          == word(0)))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_replace
entries.statement:
∀ (s j : W32) (n : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool) (b : Bool)
if
  1. val(j) < n
  2. n <= 32
  3. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
  4. ne(val(j))
then
  tlsf_sync(
    if b { s } else { word_xor(s, word_jshl(word(1), j)) },
    n,
    (k : Num) => if k == val(j) { b } else { ne(k) })

entries.name: tlsf_sync_pop_bin
entries.statement:
∀ (s j : W32) (L : (Num) -> List[W32]) (xs : List[W32])
if
  1. val(j) < 16
  2. tlsf_sync(s, 16, (i : Num) => !(L(i) == NIL))
  3. !(L(val(j)) == NIL)
then
  tlsf_sync(
    if xs == NIL { word_xor(s, word_jshl(word(1), j)) } else { s },
    16,

entries.name: tlsf_sync_pop_top
entries.statement:
∀ (fl f s : W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
if
  1. val(f) < 28
  2. tlsf_sync(fl, 28, (i : Num) => !(sb(i) == word(0)))
  3. !(sb(val(f)) == word(0))
then
  tlsf_sync(
    if s == word(0) { word_xor(fl, word_jshl(word(1), f)) } else { fl },
    28,
    (i : Num) => !(tlsf_upd(sb, val(f), s, i) == word(0)))

entries.name: tlsf_sync_occupied_nz
entries.statement:
∀ (s : W32) (n k : Num) (ne : (Num) -> Bool)
if
  1. tlsf_sync(s, n, ne)
  2. k < n
  3. ne(k)
then
  !(s == word(0))

entries.name: TLSF physical chain and bin correspondence (tlsf_physical.mbt)
tlsf_size
entries.statement: tlsf_size((hd : W32)) == word_and(hd, word(4294967292))

entries.name: tlsf_used
entries.statement: tlsf_used((hd : W32)) == !(word_and(hd, word(1)) == word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_last
entries.statement: tlsf_last((hd : W32)) == !(word_and(hd, word(2)) == word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_level_of
entries.statement:
tlsf_level_of((hd : W32)) == (val : (W32) -> Num)(
  (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
    (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
    (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd)))))

entries.name: tlsf_slot_of
entries.statement:
tlsf_slot_of((hd : W32)) == val(
  word_and(
    word_jushr(
      tlsf_size(hd),
      word_sub(word(27), word(word_clz(tlsf_size(hd))))),
    word(15)))

entries.name: tlsf_header_class_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (hd : W32)
if
  1. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd))
then
  tlsf_level_of(hd) < 28
  && tlsf_slot_of(hd) < 16

entries.name: tlsf_header_class
entries.statement:
∀ (hd : W32),
  tlsf_level_of(hd) == val(word_sub(tlsf_fli(tlsf_size(hd)), word(4)))
  && tlsf_slot_of(hd) == val(tlsf_sli(tlsf_size(hd), tlsf_fli(tlsf_size(hd))))

entries.name: tlsf_block_ok
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_ok((a : Num), (lim : Num), (m : W32), (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  val(m) == a
  && !(m == word(0))
  && MOD(a, 8) == 0
  && 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && MOD(val(tlsf_size(hd(m))), 8) == 0
  && a + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) <= lim)

entries.name: tlsf_layout
entries.statement:
tlsf_layout(
  (p : W32),
  (a : Num),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  NIL,
  (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  == (a == lim && p == top)
&& tlsf_layout(
     (p : W32),
     (a : Num),
     (lim : Num),
     (top : W32),
     CONS((m : W32), (xs : List[W32])),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
     tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
     && tlsf_last(hd(m)) == (xs == NIL)
     && tlsf_layout(m, a + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))), lim, top, xs, hd))

entries.name: tlsf_block_field_address
entries.statement:
∀ (a lim k : Num) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
  2. lim <= 4294967296
  3. k <= 16
then
  val(word_add(m, word(k))) == val(m) + k

entries.name: tlsf_block_spare_end
entries.statement:
∀ (a lim : Num) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
then
  val(m) + 16 + (val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) - 8)
    == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))

entries.name: tlsf_layout_lower
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top m : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
then
  a <= val(m)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_members
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top m : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(m, xs)
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_order
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
then
  PAIRWISE(
    (m : W32) => (n : W32) => val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) <= val(n),
    xs)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_distinct
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
then
  PAIRWISE((m : W32) => (n : W32) => !(m == n), xs)

entries.name: tlsf_count
entries.statement:
tlsf_count((m : W32), (xs : List[W32]))
  == LENGTH(FILTER((x : W32) => x == m, xs))

entries.name: tlsf_count_member
entries.statement: ∀ (m : W32) (xs : List[W32]), MEM(m, xs) == (0 < tlsf_count(m, xs))

entries.name: tlsf_count_zero
entries.statement: ∀ (m : W32) (xs : List[W32]), (tlsf_count(m, xs) == 0) == !MEM(m, xs)

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match
entries.statement:
tlsf_bins_match(
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ m : W32,
      MEM(m, xs)
      && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_count(
           m,
           bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))))
           == 1)
  && (
       ∀ f : Num,
         ∀ j : Num,
           ∀ m : W32,
             f < 28
             && j < 16
             && MEM(m, bl(f, j)) → MEM(m, xs)
             && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
             && tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == f
             && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == j))

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (m : W32)
  (f j : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. f < 28
  3. j < 16
then
  tlsf_count(m, bl(f, j)) == (
    if MEM(m, xs)
    && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == f
    && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == j { 1 } else { 0 })

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_member
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (m : W32)
  (f j : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. f < 28
  3. j < 16
then
  MEM(m, bl(f, j)) == (
    MEM(m, xs)

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_unique

  2. f < 28
  3. j < 16
  4. g < 28
  5. k < 16
  6. MEM(m, bl(f, j))
  7. MEM(m, bl(g, k))

  f == g
  && j == k
  && tlsf_count(m, bl(f, j)) == 1

tlsf_physical_ok(
  (d : W32),

  && MOD(ms, 65536) == 0
  && !(xs == NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_align
entries.statement: tlsf_align((s : W32)) == word_and(word_add(s, word(15)), word(4294967280))

entries.name: tlsf_fword_code

∀ (x : W32),

entries.name: tlsf_search_domain
entries.statement:
tlsf_search_domain((s : W32), (fl : W32), (sb : (Num) -> W32)) == (
  (

          (word_and : (W32, W32) -> W32)(fl, tlsf_cut(tlsf_search_f(s)))))
        == (word : (Num) -> W32)(32)) → (val : (W32) -> Num)(
      (word : (Num) -> W32)(
        (word_ctz : (W32) -> Num)(
          (word_and : (W32, W32) -> W32)(fl, tlsf_cut(tlsf_search_f(s)))))) < 28)
  && (
       !(
         (word : (Num) -> W32)(
           (word_ctz : (W32) -> Num)(
             (word_and : (W32, W32) -> W32)(fl, tlsf_cut(tlsf_search_f(s)))))
           == (word : (Num) -> W32)(32))
       && !(
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(
              (word_ctz : (W32) -> Num)(
                (word_and : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
                  sb(

  end
  local.get 0
  local.get 0

  i32.const 4294967294
  i32.and
  i32.const 1
  i32.or
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2

entries.name: tlsf_and_assoc

entries.name: tlsf_header_masks

∀ (h : W32) (last used : Bool),
  tlsf_size(tlsf_header(tlsf_size(h), last, used)) == tlsf_size(h)
  && word_and(tlsf_header(tlsf_size(h), last, used), word(2))
       == (if last { word(2) } else { word(0) })
  && word_and(tlsf_header(tlsf_size(h), last, used), word(1))

entries.name: tlsf_header_fields

entries.name: tlsf_end
entries.statement:
tlsf_end((p : W32), NIL) == p
&& tlsf_end((p : W32), CONS((m : W32), (xs : List[W32]))) == tlsf_end(m, xs)

entries.name: tlsf_path
entries.statement:
tlsf_path(NIL, (a : Num), (lim : Num), (hd : (W32) -> W32), (b : Num))
  == (a == b)
&& tlsf_path(
     CONS((m : W32), (xs : List[W32])),
     (a : Num),
     (lim : Num),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32),
     (b : Num)) == (
     tlsf_block_ok(a, lim, m, hd)
     && !tlsf_last(hd(m))
     && tlsf_path(xs, a + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))), lim, hd, b))

entries.name: tlsf_regions_append
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (p : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  tlsf_regions(p, APPEND(ys, zs), hd)
    == star(tlsf_regions(p, ys, hd), tlsf_regions(tlsf_end(p, ys), zs, hd))

entries.name: tlsf_layout_cut
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd) == (
    ∃ b : Num,
      tlsf_path(ys, a, lim, hd, b)
      && tlsf_layout(tlsf_end(p, ys), b, lim, top, CONS(m, zs), hd))

entries.name: tlsf_regions_cong
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p : W32) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. ∀ m : W32, MEM(m, xs) → hd(m) == nh(m)
then
  tlsf_regions(p, xs, hd) == tlsf_regions(p, xs, nh)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_cong
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. ∀ m : W32, MEM(m, xs) → hd(m) == nh(m)
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd) == tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, nh)

entries.name: tlsf_path_cong
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (a lim b : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. ∀ m : W32, MEM(m, xs) → hd(m) == nh(m)
then
  tlsf_path(xs, a, lim, hd, b) == tlsf_path(xs, a, lim, nh, b)

entries.name: tlsf_proved_spec
entries.statement:
tlsf_proved_spec(
  (addr : Num),
  (code : List[B_e]),
  (zs : List[Value]),
  (nin : Num),
  (nout : Num),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  a == addr
  && (
       ∀ args : List[Value],
         sl_triple(
           (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
           (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             vs == NIL && lc == APPEND(args, zs) && P(args, gs, ms, h),
           code,
           (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
           (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             Q(vs, gs, ms, h)))
  && (
       ∀ args : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, P(args, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(args) == nin)
  && (
       ∀ res : List[Value],
         ∀ gs : List[Value],
           ∀ ms : Num, ∀ h : Heap, Q(res, gs, ms, h) → LENGTH(res) == nout))

entries.name: tlsf_proved_specs
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (addr n : Num) (code : List[B_e])
  (zs : List[Value]) (ts ins outs : List[Valtype])
if
  1. EL(addr, fs) == Func_native(inst, Tf(ins, outs), ts, code)
  2. n_zeros(ts) == SOME(zs)
  3. call_free_b(code)
then
  specs_ok(
    n,
    tlsf_proved_spec(addr, code, zs, LENGTH(ins), LENGTH(outs)),
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst)

entries.name: tlsf_mark

tlsf_mark((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32))
  == tlsf_put(hd, m, word_or(word_and(hd(m), word(4294967294)), word(1)))

entries.name: tlsf_remainder
entries.statement: tlsf_remainder((m : W32), (n : W32)) == word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8)))

entries.name: tlsf_remainder_size

entries.name: tlsf_split_headers

  tlsf_put(hd, m, word_or(n, word(1))),
  tlsf_remainder(m, n),
  word_or(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n), word_and(hd(m), word(2))))

entries.name: tlsf_size_mask_id

entries.name: tlsf_remainder_mask

  && tlsf_used(tlsf_header(h, last, used)) == used

entries.name: tlsf_class_size

entries.name: tlsf_push_fl

entries.name: tlsf_push_sb
entries.statement:
tlsf_push_sb((hd : W32), (sb : (Num) -> W32)) == (
  tlsf_upd : ((Num) -> W32, Num, W32, Num) -> W32)(
  sb,
  (val : (W32) -> Num)(
    (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
      (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
      (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd))))),
  (word_or : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
    sb(
      (val : (W32) -> Num)(
        (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
          (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
          (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd)))))),
    (word_jshl : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
      (word : (Num) -> W32)(1),
      (word_and : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
        (word_jushr : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
          tlsf_size(hd),
          (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(
              (word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd))))),
        (word : (Num) -> W32)(15)))))

entries.name: tlsf_push_bl
entries.statement:
tlsf_push_bl((hd : W32), (m : W32), (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  tlsf_upd : ((Num, Num) -> List[W32], Num, (Num) -> List[W32], Num, Num) -> List[
    W32])(
  bl,
  (val : (W32) -> Num)(
    (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
      (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
      (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd))))),
  (tlsf_upd : ((Num) -> List[W32], Num, List[W32], Num) -> List[W32])(
    bl(
      (val : (W32) -> Num)(
        (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
          (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
          (word : (Num) -> W32)((word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd)))))),
    (val : (W32) -> Num)(
      (word_and : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
        (word_jushr : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
          tlsf_size(hd),
          (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(
              (word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd))))),
        (word : (Num) -> W32)(15))),
    (CONS : (W32, List[W32]) -> List[W32])(
      m,
      bl(
        (val : (W32) -> Num)(
          (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(
              (word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd))))),
        (val : (W32) -> Num)(
          (word_and : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
            (word_jushr : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
              tlsf_size(hd),
              (word_sub : (W32, W32) -> W32)(
                (word : (Num) -> W32)(27),
                (word : (Num) -> W32)(
                  (word_clz : (W32) -> Num)(tlsf_size(hd))))),
            (word : (Num) -> W32)(15)))))))

entries.name: tlsf_push_pre
entries.statement:
tlsf_push_pre(
  (d : W32),
  (m : W32),
  (hd : W32),
  (pf0 : W32),
  (nf0 : W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (args : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    args == [V_num(ConstInt32(m))]
    && (
         (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
           star(
             pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd)),
             star(
               pts(val(word_add(m, word(8))), serialise_i32(pf0)),
               star(
                 pts(val(word_add(m, word(12))), serialise_i32(nf0)),
                 star(tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl), fp(gs, ms))))))(gs, ms, h))

entries.name: tlsf_push_post
entries.statement:
tlsf_push_post(
  (d : W32),
  (m : W32),
  (hd : W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))]
    && (
         (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
           star(
             pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd)),
             star(
               tlsf_bins(
                 d,
                 tlsf_push_fl(hd, fl),
                 tlsf_push_sb(hd, sb),
                 tlsf_push_bl(hd, m, bl)),
               fp(gs, ms))))(gs, ms, h))

entries.name: tlsf_push_call
entries.statement:
∀ (d m hd pf0 nf0 fl : W32) (addr : Num) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. !(m == word(0))
  2. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd))
then
  tlsf_proved_spec(
    addr,
    tlsf_push_code(d),
    [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))), V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))),
     V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))],
    1,
    1,
    addr,
    tlsf_push_pre(d, m, hd, pf0, nf0, fl, sb, bl, fp),
    tlsf_push_post(d, m, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp))

entries.name: tlsf_split_no_remainder
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n hd : W32)
  (push : Num) (l1 l2 l4 l5 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. !word_ugt(word_and(hd, word(4294967292)), word_add(n, word(264)))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      false,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd)), fp(gs, ms))),
    tlsf_split_code(d, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      LENGTH(lc) == 6
      && EL(0, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(m))
      && EL(3, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(n))
      && vs == NIL
      && (
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
             star(
               pts(
                 val(m),
                 serialise_i32(
                   word_or(word_and(hd, word(4294967294)), word(1)))),
               fp(gs, ms)))(gs, ms, h),
    NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_split_head
entries.statement:
∀ (zs : List[W32]) (p top m r : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, CONS(m, zs), hd)
  2. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(nh(m)))
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(m))), 8) == 0
  4. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(nh(r)))
  5. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(r))), 8) == 0
  6. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(nh(m)))
  7. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(nh(r))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  8. !tlsf_last(nh(m))
  9. tlsf_last(nh(r)) == tlsf_last(hd(m))
  10. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_layout(
    p,
    a,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { r } else { top },
    CONS(m, CONS(r, zs)),
    nh)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_replace_head
entries.statement:
∀ (zs : List[W32]) (p top m : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, CONS(m, zs), hd)
  2. tlsf_size(nh(m)) == tlsf_size(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_last(nh(m)) == tlsf_last(hd(m))
  4. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, CONS(m, zs), nh)

entries.name: tlsf_split_last_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n hd w0 w1 pf nf fl : W32)
  (push : Num) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (l1 l2 l4 l5 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. word_ugt(word_and(hd, word(4294967292)), word_add(n, word(264)))
  2. !(word_and(hd, word(2)) == word(0))
  3. !(word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8))) == word(0))
  4. 16 <= val(
       tlsf_size(
         word_and(
           word_or(
             word_sub(word_sub(word_and(hd, word(4294967292)), n), word(8)),
             word_and(w0, word(3))),
           word(4294967294))))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    tlsf_proved_spec(
      sfunc_ind(inst, push),
      tlsf_push_code(d),
      [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))), V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))],
      1,
      1),
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      false,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2, V_num(ConstInt32(n)), l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd)),
          star(
            pts(val(word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8)))), serialise_i32(w0)),
            star(
              pts(
                val(word_add(word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8))), word(4))),
                serialise_i32(w1)),
              star(
                pts(
                  val(
                    word_add(word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8))), word(8))),
                  serialise_i32(pf)),
                star(
                  pts(
                    val(
                      word_add(
                        word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8))),
                        word(12))),
                    serialise_i32(nf)),
                  star(
                    pts(
                      val(
                        word_add(
                          word_and(
                            word_add(d, word(15)),
                            word(4294967280)),
                          word(1908))),
                      serialise_i32(m)),
                    star(tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl), fp(gs, ms))))))))),
    tlsf_split_code(d, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      LENGTH(lc) == 6
      && EL(0, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(m))
      && EL(3, lc) == V_num(ConstInt32(n))
      && vs == NIL
      && (
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
             star(
               pts(
                 val(m),
                 serialise_i32(
                   word_or(
                     word_and(
                       word_or(
                         n,
                         word_and(
                           word_and(hd, word(4294967293)),
                           word(3))),
                       word(4294967294)),
                     word(1)))),
               star(
                 pts(
                   val(word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8)))),
                   serialise_i32(
                     word_or(
                       word_and(
                         word_and(
                           word_or(
                             word_sub(
                               word_sub(
                                 word_and(hd, word(4294967292)),
                                 n),
                               word(8)),
                             word_and(w0, word(3))),
                           word(4294967294)),
                         word(4294967293)),
                       word(2)))),
                 star(
                   pts(
                     val(
                       word_add(
                         word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8))),
                         word(4))),
                     serialise_i32(m)),
                   star(
                     pts(
                       val(
                         word_add(
                           word_and(
                             word_add(d, word(15)),
                             word(4294967280)),
                           word(1908))),
                       serialise_i32(word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8))))),
                     star(
                       tlsf_bins(
                         d,
                         tlsf_push_fl(
                           word_and(
                             word_or(
                               word_sub(
                                 word_sub(
                                   word_and(hd, word(4294967292)),
                                   n),
                                 word(8)),
                               word_and(w0, word(3))),
                             word(4294967294)),
                           fl),
                         tlsf_push_sb(
                           word_and(
                             word_or(
                               word_sub(
                                 word_sub(
                                   word_and(hd, word(4294967292)),
                                   n),
                                 word(8)),
                               word_and(w0, word(3))),
                             word(4294967294)),
                           sb),
                         tlsf_push_bl(
                           word_and(
                             word_or(
                               word_sub(
                                 word_sub(
                                   word_and(hd, word(4294967292)),
                                   n),
                                 word(8)),
                               word_and(w0, word(3))),
                             word(4294967294)),
                           word_add(n, word_add(m, word(8))),
                           bl)),
                       fp(gs, ms)))))))(gs, ms, h),
    NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_split_next_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m n hd w0 w1 pf nf fl : W32)
  (push : Num) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])

if

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_transport

∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. ∀ m : W32,
       (MEM(m, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(m))) == (MEM(m, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(m)))
  2. ∀ m : W32,
       MEM(m, xs)
       && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_level_of(nh(m))
       && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_slot_of(nh(m))
then
  tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl) == tlsf_bins_match(ys, nh, bl)

entries.name: tlsf_bin_add_mem

  MEM(m, tlsf_bin_add(bl, f, j, r, i, k))
    == (MEM(m, bl(i, k)) || i == f && k == j && m == r)

entries.name: tlsf_bin_add_count_other

∀ (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (f j i k : Num) (r m : W32)
if

then

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_insert
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (r : W32) (f j : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. !MEM(r, xs)
  3. f < 28
  4. j < 16
  5. MEM(r, ys)
  6. !tlsf_used(nh(r))
  7. tlsf_level_of(nh(r)) == f
  8. tlsf_slot_of(nh(r)) == j
  9. ∀ m : W32,
       !(m == r) → (MEM(m, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(m)))
         == (MEM(m, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(m)))
       && (
            MEM(m, xs)
            && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_level_of(nh(m))
            && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_slot_of(nh(m)))
then
  tlsf_bins_match(ys, nh, tlsf_bin_add(bl, f, j, r))

  2. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  3. tlsf_layout(tlsf_end(p, ys), b, lim, top, CONS(m, zs), nh)

entries.name: tlsf_physical_split
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_used(nh(m))
  4. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  5. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == nh(x)
  6. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(nh(m)))
  7. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(m))), 8) == 0
  8. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(nh(r)))
  9. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(r))), 8) == 0
  10. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(nh(m)))
  11. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(nh(r))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  12. !tlsf_last(nh(m))
  13. tlsf_last(nh(r)) == tlsf_last(hd(m))
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { r } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))),
    nh)

entries.name: tlsf_split_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (m n : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (lim : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  2. lim <= 4294967296
  3. 16 <= val(n)
  4. val(n) <= 4160749568
  5. MOD(val(n), 16) == 0
  6. val(n) + 264 < val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
then
  val(tlsf_remainder(m, n)) == val(m) + 8 + val(n)
  && !(tlsf_remainder(m, n) == word(0))
  && !(tlsf_remainder(m, n) == m)
  && MOD(val(tlsf_remainder(m, n)), 8) == 0
  && val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) - val(n) - 8
  && 16 <= val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n))
  && MOD(val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)), 8) == 0
  && tlsf_size(n) == n
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)
  && val(n) + 8 + val(tlsf_remainder_size(hd(m), n)) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))

  && tlsf_regions(word(0), ys, tlsf_mark(hd, m))

    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    hd,
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(tlsf_remainder(m, n), zs))),

    && !tlsf_used(hd(m))

    && star(
         pts(val(word_add(tlsf_base(d), word(1908))), serialise_i32(top)),

entries.name: tlsf_extend_model
entries.statement:
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d m : W32) (lim nextlim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. lim <= nextlim
  4. nextlim <= 4294967296
  5. MOD(nextlim, 65536) == 0
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(
    d,
    nextlim,
    m,
    APPEND(ys, [m]),
    tlsf_extend_headers(hd, m, nextlim))
  && ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == tlsf_extend_headers(hd, m, nextlim, x)
  && tlsf_extend_headers(hd, m, nextlim, m)
       == word_or(tlsf_capacity_at(nextlim, m), word_and(hd(m), word(3)))
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_extend_headers(hd, m, nextlim, m))
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_extend_headers(hd, m, nextlim, m))
       == tlsf_capacity_at(nextlim, m)

∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d m : W32) (lim nextlim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if

  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. lim + 24 <= nextlim
  4. nextlim <= 4294967296
  5. MOD(nextlim, 65536) == 0
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(
    d,
    nextlim,
    word(lim),
    APPEND(ys, [m, word(lim)]),
    tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, nextlim))
  && ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, ys) → hd(x) == tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, nextlim, x)
  && tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, nextlim, m)
       == word_and(hd(m), word(4294967293))
  && tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, nextlim, word(lim))
       == word_or(tlsf_capacity_at(nextlim, word(lim)), word(2))
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, nextlim, word(lim)))
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_append_headers(hd, m, lim, nextlim, word(lim)))
       == tlsf_capacity_at(nextlim, word(lim))
  && (val : (W32) -> Num)((word : (Num) -> W32)(lim)) == lim
  && !MEM(word(lim), APPEND(ys, [m]))

entries.name: tlsf_bins_match_publish

∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (r : W32) (f j : Num)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. !(MEM(r, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(r)))
  3. f < 28
  4. j < 16
  5. MEM(r, ys)
  6. !tlsf_used(nh(r))
  7. tlsf_level_of(nh(r)) == f
  8. tlsf_slot_of(nh(r)) == j
  9. ∀ m : W32,
       !(m == r) → (MEM(m, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(m)))
         == (MEM(m, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(m)))
       && (
            MEM(m, xs)
            && !tlsf_used(hd(m)) → tlsf_level_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_level_of(nh(m))
            && tlsf_slot_of(hd(m)) == tlsf_slot_of(nh(m)))

        star(
          pts(
            val(word_add(m, word(4))),
            serialise_i32(tlsf_end(word(0), ys))),

entries.name: tlsf_ensure_growth_fit
entries.statement:
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d s m : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd)
  2. 16 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 4160749568
  4. DIV(lim, 65536) + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) <= 65536
then
  lim <= lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536
  && lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536 <= 4294967296
  && MOD(lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536, 65536) == 0
  && tlsf_physical_ok(
       d,
       lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
       tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim),
       tlsf_grow_chain(APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, m, lim),
       tlsf_grow_headers(
         hd,
         m,
         lim,
         lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536))
  && !tlsf_used(
       tlsf_grow_headers(
         hd,
         m,
         lim,
         lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
         tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim)))
  && val(tlsf_ensure_expected(s)) <= val(
       tlsf_size(
         tlsf_grow_headers(
           hd,
           m,
           lim,
           lim + val(tlsf_ensure_pages(s, hd(m))) * 65536,
           tlsf_grow_top(hd, m, lim))))

  (rest : List[B_e]) (labels : List[SAssn])

  1. lim <= 4294967296
  2. ∀ gs : List[Value],
       ∀ ms : Num,
         ∀ h : Heap,
           (
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
               ms == lim && R(gs, lim, h))(gs, ms, h) → rp(
             [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))],
             lc0,
             gs,
             ms,
             h)
  3. DIV(lim, 65536) + val(c) <= 65536 → sl_triple_g(
       G,
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       rp,
       st(
         NIL,
         lc0,
         (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
           ms == lim + val(c) * 65536
           && star(
                R(gs, lim),
                pts(lim, REPLICATE(val(c) * 65536, word(0))),
                h)),
       rest,
       Q,
       labels)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(c))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim && R(gs, ms, h)),
    APPEND([Memory_grow], APPEND(tlsf_ensure_guard(d, pop, push), rest)),
    Q,
    labels)

  local.get 0
  call push

entries.name: tlsf_free_prev_body_parts
entries.statement:
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_prev_body(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_prev_args(d, pop, push),
    APPEND([Call(pop)], tlsf_free_prev_write(d, pop, push)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_next_body_parts
entries.statement:
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_next_body(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_next_args(d, pop, push),
    APPEND([Call(pop)], tlsf_free_next_write(d, pop, push)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_prev_parts
entries.statement:
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_prev(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_prev_test(d, pop, push),
    [If(Tbv(NONE), tlsf_free_prev_body(d, pop, push), NIL)])

entries.name: tlsf_free_next_parts
entries.statement:
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_next(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_next_test(d, pop, push),
    [If(Tbv(NONE), tlsf_free_next_body(d, pop, push), NIL)])

entries.name: tlsf_free_code_parts
entries.statement:
∀ (d : W32) (pop push : Num),
  tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push) == APPEND(
    tlsf_free_clear(d, pop, push),
    APPEND(
      tlsf_free_prev(d, pop, push),
      APPEND(tlsf_free_next(d, pop, push), tlsf_free_publish(d, pop, push))))

entries.name: tlsf_release
entries.statement:
tlsf_release((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32))
  == tlsf_put(hd, m, word_and(hd(m), word(4294967294)))

entries.name: tlsf_merge_size
entries.statement:
tlsf_merge_size((a : W32), (b : W32))
  == word_add(word_add(tlsf_size(a), tlsf_size(b)), word(8))

entries.name: tlsf_merge_header
entries.statement:
tlsf_merge_header((a : W32), (b : W32))
  == word_or(tlsf_merge_size(a, b), word_and(b, word(2)))

entries.name: tlsf_merge_headers
entries.statement:
tlsf_merge_headers((hd : (W32) -> W32), (m : W32), (r : W32))
  == tlsf_put(hd, m, tlsf_merge_header(hd(m), hd(r)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_geom
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_geom(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (m : W32))
  == tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, tlsf_mark(hd, m))

entries.name: tlsf_free_pending
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_pending(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (ys : List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (zs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
    && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
    && star(
         pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top)),
         star(
           tlsf_regions(word(0), ys, hd),
           star(
             pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd(m))),
             star(
               pts(
                 val(word_add(m, word(4))),
                 serialise_i32(tlsf_end(word(0), ys))),
               star(
                 tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))),
                 star(tlsf_regions(m, zs, hd), tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl)))))),
         h))

entries.name: tlsf_free_pre
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_pre(
  (d : W32),
  (m : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (args : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    args == [V_num(ConstInt32(m))]
    && ms == lim
    && MEM(m, xs)
    && tlsf_used(hd(m))
    && star(
         tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
         star(tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))), fp(gs, ms)),
         h))

entries.name: tlsf_free_post
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_post(
  (d : W32),
  (m : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))]
    && ms == lim
    && (
         ∃ top2 : W32,
           ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
             ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl2 : W32,
                 ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     ∃ r : W32,
                       MEM(r, xs2)
                       && !tlsf_used(hd2(r))
                       && val(r) <= val(m)
                       && val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) <= val(r) + 8 + val(
                            tlsf_size(hd2(r)))
                       && (
                            ∀ x : W32,
                              MEM(x, xs)
                              && !(x == m)
                              && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2)
                              && hd2(x) == hd(x))
                       && star(
                            tlsf_large(d, lim, top2, xs2, hd2, fl2, sb2, bl2),
                            fp(gs, ms),
                            h)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_pair
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_pair(
  (d : W32),
  (top : W32),
  (ys : List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (r : W32),
  (zs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])) == star(
  pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top)),
  star(
    tlsf_regions(word(0), ys, hd),
    star(
      pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hd(m))),
      star(
        pts(val(word_add(m, word(4))), serialise_i32(tlsf_end(word(0), ys))),
        star(
          tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))),
          star(
            pts(val(r), serialise_i32(hd(r))),
            star(
              pts(val(word_add(r, word(4))), serialise_i32(m)),
              star(
                tlsf_bytes(val(r) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))),
                star(tlsf_regions(r, zs, hd), tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl))))))))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_end_append
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (p : W32),
  tlsf_end(p, APPEND(ys, zs)) == tlsf_end(tlsf_end(p, ys), zs)

entries.name: tlsf_free_left
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_left((ys : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  == (ys == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(tlsf_end(word(0), ys))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_right
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_right((zs : List[W32]), (hd : (W32) -> W32))
  == (zs == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(HD(zs))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_covers
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_covers(
  (m0 : W32),
  (hd0 : (W32) -> W32),
  (m : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  val(m) <= val(m0)
  && val(m0) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd0(m0))) <= val(m) + 8 + val(
       tlsf_size(hd(m))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_live
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_live(
  (xs0 : List[W32]),
  (hd0 : (W32) -> W32),
  (m0 : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32)) == (
  ∀ x : W32,
    MEM(x, xs0)
    && !(x == m0)
    && tlsf_used(hd0(x)) → MEM(x, xs)
    && hd(x) == hd0(x))

entries.name: tlsf_free_work
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_work(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (m0 : W32),
  (xs0 : List[W32]),
  (hd0 : (W32) -> W32),
  (fp : GProp),
  (left : Bool),
  (right : Bool)) == (
  (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
  (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    vs == NIL
    && ms == lim
    && (
         ∃ top : W32,
           ∃ ys : List[W32],
             ∃ m : W32,
               ∃ zs : List[W32],
                 ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                   ∃ fl : W32,
                     ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                       ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                         ∃ l1 : Value,
                           ∃ l2 : Value,
                             lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2]
                             && tlsf_free_geom(
                                  d,
                                  lim,
                                  top,
                                  APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                                  hd,
                                  m)
                             && !tlsf_used(hd(m))
                             && tlsf_bins_match(
                                  APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                                  tlsf_mark(hd, m),
                                  bl)
                             && tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
                             && tlsf_free_live(
                                  xs0,
                                  hd0,
                                  m0,
                                  APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
                                  hd)
                             && (!left || tlsf_free_left(ys, hd))
                             && (!right || tlsf_free_right(zs, hd))
                             && star(
                                  tlsf_free_pending(
                                    d,
                                    lim,
                                    top,
                                    ys,
                                    m,
                                    zs,
                                    hd,
                                    fl,
                                    sb,
                                    bl),
                                  fp(gs, ms),
                                  h)))

entries.name: tlsf_release_fields
entries.statement:
∀ (h : W32),
  tlsf_size(word_and(h, word(4294967294))) == tlsf_size(h)
  && tlsf_last(word_and(h, word(4294967294))) == tlsf_last(h)
  && !tlsf_used(word_and(h, word(4294967294)))

entries.name: tlsf_layout_fields
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, xs) → tlsf_size(hd(x)) == tlsf_size(nh(x))
       && tlsf_last(hd(x)) == tlsf_last(nh(x))
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd) == tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, nh)

entries.name: tlsf_free_bins_transport
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  2. ∀ x : W32,
       (MEM(x, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(x))) == (MEM(x, ys) && !tlsf_used(nh(x)))
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, xs) && !tlsf_used(hd(x)) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_bins_match(ys, nh, bl)

entries.name: tlsf_free_mark_fields
entries.statement:
∀ (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m x : W32),
  tlsf_size(tlsf_mark(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_size(hd(x))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_mark(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_last(hd(x))
  && tlsf_used(tlsf_mark(hd, m, x)) == (x == m || tlsf_used(hd(x)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_release_fields
entries.statement:
∀ (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m x : W32),
  tlsf_size(tlsf_release(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_size(hd(x))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_release(hd, m, x)) == tlsf_last(hd(x))
  && tlsf_used(tlsf_release(hd, m, x)) == (!(x == m) && tlsf_used(hd(x)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_layout_mark
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p top m : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, tlsf_mark(hd, m))
    == tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd)

entries.name: tlsf_free_geom_facts
entries.statement:
∀ (d top m : W32) (lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, xs, hd, m) == (
    val(d) <= 4294965088
    && lim <= 4294967296
    && MOD(lim, 65536) == 0
    && !(xs == NIL)
    && tlsf_layout(word(0), tlsf_origin(d), lim, top, xs, hd)
    && tlsf_coalesced(xs, tlsf_mark(hd, m)))

entries.name: tlsf_layout_prev
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p q top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. !(xs == NIL)
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, xs, hd) == tlsf_layout(q, a, lim, top, xs, hd)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_contract_head
entries.statement:
∀ (zs : List[W32]) (p top m r : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs)), hd)
  2. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(m))), 8) == 0
  4. tlsf_last(nh(m)) == tlsf_last(hd(r))
  5. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, zs) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, if zs == NIL { m } else { top }, CONS(m, zs), nh)

entries.name: tlsf_layout_contract
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (p top m r : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  2. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(nh(m))), 8) == 0
  4. tlsf_last(nh(m)) == tlsf_last(hd(r))
  5. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → hd(x) == nh(x)
then
  tlsf_layout(
    p,
    a,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    nh)

entries.name: tlsf_coalesced_focus
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd) == (
    tlsf_coalesced(ys, hd)
    && tlsf_coalesced(zs, hd)
    && (ys == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(tlsf_end(word(0), ys))) || tlsf_used(hd(m)))
    && (zs == NIL || tlsf_used(hd(m)) || tlsf_used(hd(HD(zs)))))

entries.name: tlsf_coalesced_contract
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r : W32) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  2. tlsf_used(nh(m))
  3. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → tlsf_used(hd(x)) == tlsf_used(nh(x))
then
  tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), nh)

entries.name: tlsf_free_end_member
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. !(xs == NIL)
then
  MEM(tlsf_end(p, xs), xs)

entries.name: tlsf_free_ready_cong
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, xs) → tlsf_used(hd(x)) == tlsf_used(nh(x))
then
  tlsf_free_left(xs, hd) == tlsf_free_left(xs, nh)
  && tlsf_free_right(xs, hd) == tlsf_free_right(xs, nh)

entries.name: tlsf_free_left_transfer
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_left(xs, hd)
  2. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, xs) → tlsf_used(hd(x)) == tlsf_used(nh(x))
then
  tlsf_free_left(xs, nh)

entries.name: tlsf_free_right_transfer
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_right(xs, hd)
  2. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, xs) → tlsf_used(hd(x)) == tlsf_used(nh(x))
then
  tlsf_free_right(xs, nh)

entries.name: tlsf_free_coalesced_neighbours
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_coalesced(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
then
  tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  && tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)

entries.name: tlsf_free_ready_physical
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  2. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  3. tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)
then
  tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)

entries.name: tlsf_merge_aligned
entries.statement:
∀ (a b : Num)
if
  1. MOD(a, 8) == 0
  2. MOD(b, 8) == 0
then
  MOD(a + b + 8, 8) == 0

entries.name: tlsf_merge_size_fields
entries.statement:
∀ (a b : W32)
if
  1. val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8 < 4294967296
  2. MOD(val(tlsf_size(a)), 8) == 0
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(b)), 8) == 0
then
  val(tlsf_merge_size(a, b)) == val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8
  && MOD(val(tlsf_merge_size(a, b)), 8) == 0
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_size(a, b)) == tlsf_merge_size(a, b)

entries.name: tlsf_merge_header_fields
entries.statement:
∀ (a b : W32)
if
  1. val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8 < 4294967296
  2. MOD(val(tlsf_size(a)), 8) == 0
  3. MOD(val(tlsf_size(b)), 8) == 0
then
  tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_header(a, b)) == tlsf_merge_size(a, b)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_header(a, b))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_merge_header(a, b)) == tlsf_last(b)
  && val(tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_header(a, b)))
       == val(tlsf_size(a)) + val(tlsf_size(b)) + 8

entries.name: tlsf_free_flags_split
entries.statement:
∀ (h : W32),
  word_and(h, word(3)) == word_or(word_and(h, word(1)), word_and(h, word(2)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_low_flags
entries.statement:
∀ (h : W32)
if
  1. !tlsf_used(h)
  2. !tlsf_last(h)
then
  word_and(h, word(3)) == word(0)

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_store_last
entries.statement:
∀ (hm hr : W32)
if
  1. !tlsf_used(hm)
  2. !tlsf_last(hm)
  3. tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_size(hm, hr)) == tlsf_merge_size(hm, hr)
  4. tlsf_last(hr)
then
  word_or(
    word_and(
      word_or(word_and(hm, word(3)), tlsf_merge_size(hm, hr)),
      word(4294967293)),
    word(2))
    == tlsf_merge_header(hm, hr)

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_store_next
entries.statement:
∀ (hm hr : W32)
if
  1. !tlsf_used(hm)
  2. !tlsf_last(hm)
  3. tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_size(hm, hr)) == tlsf_merge_size(hm, hr)
  4. !tlsf_last(hr)
then
  word_or(word_and(hm, word(3)), tlsf_merge_size(hm, hr))
    == tlsf_merge_header(hm, hr)

entries.name: tlsf_free_begin_model
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (m d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
then
  tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, xs, tlsf_release(hd, m), m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_release(hd, m, m))
  && tlsf_size(tlsf_release(hd, m, m)) == tlsf_size(hd(m))
  && tlsf_bins_match(xs, tlsf_mark(tlsf_release(hd, m), m), bl)
  && ∀ x : W32, !(x == m) → tlsf_release(hd, m, x) == hd(x)

entries.name: tlsf_free_release_live
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m : W32),
  tlsf_free_live(xs, hd, m, xs, tlsf_release(hd, m))

entries.name: tlsf_free_release_covers
entries.statement: ∀ (hd : (W32) -> W32) (m : W32), tlsf_free_covers(m, hd, m, tlsf_release(hd, m))

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_live
entries.statement:
∀ (xs0 ys zs : List[W32]) (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (m0 m r : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
then
  tlsf_free_live(
    xs0,
    hd0,
    m0,
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_covers
entries.statement:
∀ (m0 active m r : W32) (hd0 hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, active, hd)
  2. active == m || active == r
  3. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  4. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
then
  tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, nh)

entries.name: tlsf_free_work_fold
entries.statement:
∀ (d m0 top m fl : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs0 ys zs : List[W32])
  (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (fp : GProp) (left right : Bool) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 : Value) (vs lc gs : List[Value])
  (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  4. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
  5. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  6. !left || tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  7. !right || tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)
  8. st(
       NIL,
       [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
       (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
         ms == lim
         && star(
              tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
              fp(gs, ms),
              h),
       vs,
       lc,
       gs,
       ms,
       h)
then
  tlsf_free_work(d, lim, m0, xs0, hd0, fp, left, right, vs, lc, gs, ms, h)

entries.name: tlsf_free_pair_facts
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r p top : W32) (a lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_layout(p, a, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  2. lim <= 4294967296
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  && tlsf_block_ok(val(r), lim, r, hd)
  && val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && !tlsf_last(hd(m))
  && tlsf_last(hd(r)) == (zs == NIL)
  && !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
  && !MEM(r, ys)
  && !MEM(r, zs)
  && !(m == r)
  && val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + val(tlsf_size(hd(r))) + 8 < 4294967296

entries.name: tlsf_free_pair_geometry
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r d top active : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, active)
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(m), lim, m, hd)
  && tlsf_block_ok(val(r), lim, r, hd)
  && val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  && !tlsf_last(hd(m))
  && tlsf_last(hd(r)) == (zs == NIL)
  && !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
  && !MEM(r, ys)
  && !MEM(r, zs)
  && !(m == r)
  && val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + val(tlsf_size(hd(r))) + 8 < 4294967296

entries.name: tlsf_free_successor
entries.statement:
∀ (m r h : W32)
if
  1. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(h))
then
  r == word_add(word_add(m, tlsf_size(h)), word(8))

entries.name: tlsf_free_successor_prev
entries.statement:
∀ (m r h : W32)
if
  1. r == word_add(word_add(m, tlsf_size(h)), word(8))
then
  word_add(word_add(m, tlsf_size(h)), word(12)) == word_add(r, word(4))

entries.name: tlsf_free_member
entries.statement:
∀ (d top active x : W32) (lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, xs, hd, active)
  2. MEM(x, xs)
then
  tlsf_block_ok(val(x), lim, x, hd)
  && lim <= 4294967296

entries.name: tlsf_free_last
entries.statement:
∀ (ys : List[W32]) (d top m : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, [m]), hd, m)
then
  top == m
  && tlsf_last(hd(m))

entries.name: tlsf_free_next_geometry
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (d top m n : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(n, zs))), hd, m)
then
  !tlsf_last(hd(m))
  && n == word_add(word_add(m, tlsf_size(hd(m))), word(8))
  && !(m == n)
  && tlsf_block_ok(val(n), lim, n, hd)

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_bins
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r a b : W32) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))),
       tlsf_mark(tlsf_mark(hd, a), b),
       bl)
  2. a == m && b == r || a == r && b == m
  3. !(m == r)
  4. !MEM(r, ys)
  5. !MEM(r, zs)
then
  tlsf_bins_match(
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_mark(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r), m),
    bl)

entries.name: tlsf_free_bin_decompose
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (a b : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, tlsf_mark(hd, a), bl)
  2. !(a == b)
  3. MEM(b, xs)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(b))
  5. 16 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(b)))
then
  ∃ (us vs : List[W32]),
    bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(b)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(b))) == APPEND(us, CONS(b, vs))

entries.name: tlsf_free_pop_bins_pair
entries.statement:
∀ (xs us vs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (a b : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_bins_match(xs, tlsf_mark(hd, a), bl)
  2. !(a == b)
  3. MEM(b, xs)
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(b))
  5. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(b)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(b))) == APPEND(us, CONS(b, vs))
then
  tlsf_bins_match(
    xs,
    tlsf_mark(tlsf_mark(hd, a), b),
    tlsf_pop_bl(hd(b), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_model
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r active d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, active)
  2. active == m || active == r
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
then
  tlsf_free_geom(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r),
    m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m))
  && val(tlsf_size(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m)))
       == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  && tlsf_last(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m)) == tlsf_last(hd(r))
  && ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → hd(x) == tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, x)
  && !(m == r)
  && !MEM(m, ys)
  && !MEM(m, zs)
  && !MEM(r, ys)
  && !MEM(r, zs)

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_prev_ready
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, r)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
then
  tlsf_free_left(ys, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_next_ready
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (m r d top : W32) (lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  4. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
then
  tlsf_free_left(ys, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_right(zs, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_prev_work
entries.statement:
∀ (xs0 ys zs us vs : List[W32]) (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (m0 m r d top : W32)
  (lim : Num) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, r)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), tlsf_mark(hd, r), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, r, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  7. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(m)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(m))) == APPEND(us, CONS(m, vs))
then
  tlsf_free_geom(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r),
    m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m))
  && tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_mark(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r), m),
       tlsf_pop_bl(hd(m), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
  && tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_live(
       xs0,
       hd0,
       m0,
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_left(ys, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_next_work
entries.statement:
∀ (xs0 ys zs us vs : List[W32]) (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (m0 m r d top : W32)
  (lim : Num) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(r))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, CONS(r, zs))), hd)
  7. bl(tlsf_level_of(hd(r)), tlsf_slot_of(hd(r))) == APPEND(us, CONS(r, vs))
  8. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
then
  tlsf_free_geom(
    d,
    lim,
    if zs == NIL { m } else { top },
    APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
    tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r),
    m)
  && !tlsf_used(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r, m))
  && tlsf_bins_match(
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_mark(tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r), m),
       tlsf_pop_bl(hd(r), bl, APPEND(us, vs)))
  && tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_live(
       xs0,
       hd0,
       m0,
       APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
       tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_left(ys, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))
  && tlsf_free_right(zs, tlsf_merge_headers(hd, m, r))

entries.name: tlsf_bytes_two_words
entries.statement:
∀ (a : Num),
  tlsf_bytes(a, 8) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ x : W32,
        ∃ y : W32,
          star(pts(a, serialise_i32(x)), pts(a + 4, serialise_i32(y)), h))

entries.name: tlsf_free_join_bytes
entries.statement:
∀ (a n b : Num) (x y : W32) (R : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. star(
       tlsf_bytes(a, n),
       star(
         pts(a + n, serialise_i32(x)),
         star(
           pts(a + n + 4, serialise_i32(y)),
           star(tlsf_bytes(a + n + 8, b), R))),
       h)
then
  star(tlsf_bytes(a, n + 8 + b), R, h)

entries.name: tlsf_free_clear_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (d m h : W32) (pop push : Num) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp),
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(pts(val(m), serialise_i32(h)), fp(gs, ms))),
    tlsf_free_clear(d, pop, push),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(word_and(h, word(4294967294)))),
          fp(gs, ms))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_prev_zero_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (d m h p : W32) (pop push : Num) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. true
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      (NIL : List[Value]),
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(
            (val : (W32) -> Num)(
              (word_add : (W32, W32) -> W32)(m, (word : (Num) -> W32)(4))),
            serialise_i32((word : (Num) -> W32)(0))),
          fp(gs, ms))),
    tlsf_free_prev_test(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [
        V_num(
          ConstInt32(
            wasm_bool((word : (Num) -> W32)(1) == (word : (Num) -> W32)(0))))],
      [
        V_num(ConstInt32(m)),
        V_num(
          ConstInt32(
            (word_add : (W32, W32) -> W32)(m, (word : (Num) -> W32)(4)))),
        l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(
            (val : (W32) -> Num)(
              (word_add : (W32, W32) -> W32)(m, (word : (Num) -> W32)(4))),
            serialise_i32((word : (Num) -> W32)(0))),
          fp(gs, ms))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_prev_nonzero_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (d m h p : W32) (pop push : Num) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. !(p == word(0))
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(word_add(m, word(4))), serialise_i32(p)),
          star(pts(val(p), serialise_i32(h)), fp(gs, ms)))),
    tlsf_free_prev_test(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(wasm_bool(word_and(h, word(1)) == word(0))))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(m, word(4)))), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(word_add(m, word(4))), serialise_i32(p)),
          star(pts(val(p), serialise_i32(h)), fp(gs, ms)))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_next_last_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (d m h nh : W32) (pop push : Num) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. !(word_and(h, word(2)) == word(0))
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      (NIL : List[Value]),
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(pts((val : (W32) -> Num)(m), serialise_i32(h)), fp(gs, ms))),
    tlsf_free_next_test(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [
        V_num(
          ConstInt32(
            wasm_bool((word : (Num) -> W32)(1) == (word : (Num) -> W32)(0))))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(pts((val : (W32) -> Num)(m), serialise_i32(h)), fp(gs, ms))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_next_nonlast_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (d m h nh : W32) (pop push : Num) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. word_and(h, word(2)) == word(0)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(h)),
          star(
            pts(
              val(
                word_add(
                  word_add(m, word_and(h, word(4294967292))),
                  word(8))),
              serialise_i32(nh)),
            fp(gs, ms)))),
    tlsf_free_next_test(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(wasm_bool(word_and(nh, word(1)) == word(0))))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(m), serialise_i32(h)),
          star(
            pts(
              val(
                word_add(
                  word_add(m, word_and(h, word(4294967292))),
                  word(8))),
              serialise_i32(nh)),
            fp(gs, ms)))))

entries.name: tlsf_free_prev_args_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (d m r hm : W32) (pop push : Num) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp),
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(r)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>

      [V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(r)), V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>

entries.name: tlsf_free_next_args_raw
entries.statement:
∀ (d m r hm : W32) (pop push : Num) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp),
  sl_triple(

      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(pts(val(m), serialise_i32(hm)), fp(gs, ms))),
    tlsf_free_next_args(d, pop, push),
    st(
      [
        V_num(
          ConstInt32(
            word_add(word_add(m, word_and(hm, word(4294967292))), word(8))))],

        V_num(ConstInt32(m)),
        V_num(
          ConstInt32(
            word_add(word_add(m, word_and(hm, word(4294967292))), word(8)))),

entries.name: tlsf_free_if_taken
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp Q : SAssn)
  (lc : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (body : List[B_e])
  (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. !(c == word(0))
  2. ∀ ls2 : List[SAssn],
       sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(NIL, lc, R), body, Q, ls2)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st([V_num(ConstInt32(c))], lc, R),
    [If(Tbv(NONE), body, NIL)],
    Q,
    labels)

entries.name: tlsf_free_if_skipped
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp Q : SAssn)
  (lc : List[Value]) (R : GProp) (c : W32) (body : List[B_e])
  (labels : List[SAssn])
if
  1. c == word(0)
  2. ∀ ls2 : List[SAssn],
       sl_triple_g(G, fs, tabs, inst, rp, st(NIL, lc, R), NIL, Q, ls2)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,

entries.name: tlsf_free_merge_close
entries.statement:
∀ (ys zs : List[W32]) (d top m r fl : W32) (lim : Num) (hd nh : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), nh, m)
  2. !tlsf_used(nh(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(nh, m), bl)
  4. val(r) == val(m) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))
  5. val(word_add(r, word(4))) == val(r) + 4
  6. val(tlsf_size(nh(m))) == val(tlsf_size(hd(m))) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))
  7. ∀ x : W32, MEM(x, APPEND(ys, zs)) → nh(x) == hd(x)
  8. star(
       pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top)),
       star(
         tlsf_regions(word(0), ys, hd),
         star(
           pts(val(m), serialise_i32(nh(m))),
           star(
             pts(
               val(word_add(m, word(4))),
               serialise_i32(tlsf_end(word(0), ys))),
             star(
               tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))),
               star(
                 pts(val(r), serialise_i32(hd(r))),
                 star(
                   pts(val(word_add(r, word(4))), serialise_i32(m)),
                   star(
                     tlsf_bytes(val(r) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(r)))),
                     star(
                       tlsf_regions(m, zs, hd),
                       star(tlsf_bins(d, fl, sb, bl), fp))))))))),
       h)
then
  star(tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, nh, fl, sb, bl), fp, h)

entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (ys zs : List[W32]) (m d top fl : W32)
  (pop push lim : Num) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  2. tlsf_used(hd(m))
  3. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, bl)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_large(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, fl, sb, bl),
             star(tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))), fp(gs, ms)),
             h)),
    tlsf_free_clear(d, pop, push),
    tlsf_free_work(d, lim, m, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, fp, false, false),
    labels)

entries.name: tlsf_free_publish_call
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32)
  (push lim : Num) (ys zs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (lc0 : List[Value]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
             fp(gs, ms),
             h)),
    [Call(push)],
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))],
      lc0,
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_large(
               d,
               lim,
               top,
               APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)),
               hd,
               tlsf_push_fl(hd(m), fl),
               tlsf_push_sb(hd(m), sb),
               tlsf_push_bl(hd(m), m, bl)),
             fp(gs, ms),
             h)),
    NIL)
