entries.name: tlsf_free_finish_focused
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (d m0 top0 fl0 top m fl : W32) (pop push lim : Num)
  (xs0 ys zs : List[W32]) (hd0 hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb0 sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl0 bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (l1 l2 : Value)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  2. tlsf_free_geom(d, lim, top, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd, m)
  3. !tlsf_used(hd(m))
  4. tlsf_bins_match(APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), tlsf_mark(hd, m), bl)
  5. tlsf_free_covers(m0, hd0, m, hd)
  6. tlsf_free_live(xs0, hd0, m0, APPEND(ys, CONS(m, zs)), hd)
  7. tlsf_free_left(ys, hd)
  8. tlsf_free_right(zs, hd)
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), l1, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_free_pending(d, lim, top, ys, m, zs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
             fp(gs, ms),
             h)),
    tlsf_free_publish(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_free_post(
        d,
        m0,
        lim,
        top0,
        xs0,
        hd0,
        fl0,
        sb0,
        bl0,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    labels)

∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (d m0 top0 fl0 : W32) (pop push lim : Num)
  (xs0 : List[W32]) (hd0 : (W32) -> W32) (sb0 : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl0 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    tlsf_free_work(d, lim, m0, xs0, hd0, fp, true, true),
    tlsf_free_publish(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_free_post(
        d,
        m0,
        lim,
        top0,
        xs0,
        hd0,
        fl0,
        sb0,
        bl0,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    labels)

entries.name: tlsf_free_body_focused
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32)
  (pop push lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  3. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  4. tlsf_bins_match(xs, hd, bl)
  5. MEM(m, xs)
  6. tlsf_used(hd(m))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, vs, gs, ms, h),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(m)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
             star(tlsf_bytes(val(m) + 8, val(tlsf_size(hd(m)))), fp(gs, ms)),
             h)),
    tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, vs, gs, ms, h),
    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
      (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        tlsf_free_post(d, m, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl, fp, vs, gs, ms, h)])

  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp) (args : List[Value])
if

       inst,

       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],

    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>

entries.name: tlsf_free_spec
entries.statement:
tlsf_free_spec(
  (inst : Inst),
  (d : W32),
  (pop : Num),
  (push : Num),
  (free_idx : Num),
  (a : Num),
  (P : FProp),
  (Q : FProp)) == (
  a == sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx)
  && (
       ∃ m : W32,
         ∃ lim : Num,
           ∃ top : W32,
             ∃ xs : List[W32],
               ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
                 ∃ fl : W32,
                   ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,
                     ∃ bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                         P == tlsf_free_pre(
                           d,
                           m,
                           lim,
                           top,
                           xs,
                           hd,
                           fl,
                           sb,
                           bl,
                           fp)
                         && Q == tlsf_free_post(
                              d,
                              m,
                              lim,
                              top,
                              xs,
                              hd,
                              fl,
                              sb,
                              bl,
                              fp)))

entries.name: tlsf_free_all
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d m top fl : W32)
  (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (xs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (fp : GProp)
  (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_free_pre(
             d,
             m,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             fp,
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(free_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_free_post(
             d,
             m,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)

  == pts(val(tlsf_base(d)), REPLICATE(lim - val(tlsf_base(d)), word(0)))

entries.name: tlsf_initialize_valid

  val(d) <= 4294965088
  && val(tlsf_base(d)) <= lim
  && lim <= 4294967296
  && MOD(lim, 65536) == 0)

entries.name: tlsf_initialize_pre
entries.statement:
tlsf_initialize_pre((d : W32), (lim : Num), (before : Heap), (fp : GProp)) == (
  (args : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    args == NIL
    && tlsf_initialize_valid(d, lim)
    && ms == lim
    && h == before
    && star(tlsf_initialize_zero(d, lim), fp(gs, lim), h))

entries.name: tlsf_initialize_post
entries.statement:
tlsf_initialize_post((d : W32), (lim : Num), (before : Heap), (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == NIL
    && ms == tlsf_initialize_limit(d, lim)
    && star(
         tlsf_large(
           d,
           ms,
           tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
           [tlsf_initialize_origin(d)],
           tlsf_initialize_headers(d, ms),
           tlsf_push_fl(tlsf_initialize_header(d, ms), word(0)),
           tlsf_push_sb(tlsf_initialize_header(d, ms), (f : Num) => word(0)),
           tlsf_push_bl(
             tlsf_initialize_header(d, ms),
             tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
             (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL)),
         star(
           pts(val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912, REPLICATE(264, word(0))),
           fp(gs, lim)),
         h))

entries.name: tlsf_initialize_work
entries.statement:
tlsf_initialize_work(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (h0 : W32),
  (published : Bool),
  (top : W32),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && star(
         pts(val(tlsf_top_cell(d)), serialise_i32(top)),
         star(
           pts(val(tlsf_initialize_origin(d)), serialise_i32(h0)),
           star(
             pts(
               val(word_add(tlsf_initialize_origin(d), word(4))),
               serialise_i32(word(0))),
             star(
               tlsf_spare(
                 tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                 tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim)),
               star(
                 pts(val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912, REPLICATE(264, word(0))),
                 star(
                   if published {
                     tlsf_bins(
                       d,
                       tlsf_push_fl(
                         tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                         word(0)),
                       tlsf_push_sb(
                         tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                         (f : Num) => word(0)),
                       tlsf_push_bl(
                         tlsf_initialize_header(d, lim),
                         tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                         (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL)) } else {
                     star(
                       pts(
                         val(
                           word_add(
                             tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                             word(8))),
                         serialise_i32(word(0))),
                       star(
                         pts(
                           val(
                             word_add(
                               tlsf_initialize_origin(d),
                               word(12))),
                           serialise_i32(word(0))),
                         tlsf_bins(
                           d,
                           word(0),
                           (f : Num) => word(0),
                           (f : Num) => (j : Num) => NIL))) },
                   fp(gs, ms)))))),
         h))

entries.name: tlsf_initialize_run
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32) (j push lim : Num)
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (lc0 vs : List[Value]) (fr : HProp)
  (s s2 : Wstore) (f f2 : Wframe) (es2 : List[Einstr])
if
  1. tlsf_initialize_valid(d, lim)
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, j), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf(NIL, NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_initialize_code(d, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  4. keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(
         st(
           NIL,
           lc0,
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
             tlsf_initialize_pre(d, lim, before, fp, NIL, gs, ms, h)),
         fr),
       s,
       f,
       vs)
  5. reduce_trans(
       (s, f, APPEND(MAP(v_to_e, vs), [Basic(Call(j))])),
       (s2, f2, es2))
then
  ∃ (res : List[Value]),
    es2 == MAP(v_to_e, res)
    && keep(
         fs,
         tabs,
         inst,
         lift(
           st(
             NIL,
             lc0,
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
               tlsf_initialize_post(d, lim, before, fp, NIL, gs, ms, h)),
           fr),
         s2,
         f2,
         res)
or
  es2 == [Trap]
  && keep(
       fs,
       tabs,
       inst,
       lift(tlsf_initialize_abort(d, lim, before, fp), fr),
       s2,
       f2,
       NIL)
or
  ∃ (s3 : Wstore) (f3 : Wframe) (es3 : List[Einstr]),
    reduce(s2, f2, es2, s3, f3, es3)

entries.name: tlsf_small_total
entries.statement: tlsf_small_total((s : Num)) == DIV(1056, 8 + s)

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_slot((p : W32), (s : Num), (i : Num))
  == word(val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * i)

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_slots((p : W32), (s : Num), 0) == NIL
&& tlsf_small_slots((p : W32), (s : Num), SUC((n : Num)))
     == APPEND(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n), [tlsf_small_slot(p, s, n)])

entries.name: tlsf_small_used
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_used((cached : List[W32]), (live : List[W32]))
  == LENGTH(cached) + LENGTH(live)

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_partition(
  (p : W32),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ b : W32,
      tlsf_count(b, APPEND(loc, APPEND(cached, live))) == (
        if MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) { 1 } else {
          0 }))
  && LENGTH(loc) + tlsf_small_used(cached, live) == tlsf_small_total(s))

entries.name: tlsf_small_page_ok
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_page_ok(
  (lim : Num),
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == (
  !(p == word(0))
  && MOD(val(p), 8) == 0
  && lim <= 4294967296
  && val(p) + 8 + cap <= lim
  && 1080 <= cap
  && 8 <= s
  && s <= 256
  && MOD(s, 8) == 0
  && tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_lists_ok
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_lists_ok(
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (
    ∀ p : W32,
      MEM(p, ps) → tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
      && 0 < tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
      && (
           ∀ b : W32,
             MEM(b, cached(p)) → tlsf_count(b, fast(DIV(sz(p), 8))) == 1)
      && (
           tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) → tlsf_count(
             p,
             partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))
             == 1))
  && (
       ∀ j : Num,
         ∀ b : W32,
           j < 33
           && MEM(b, fast(j)) → (
                ∃ p : W32, MEM(p, ps) && sz(p) == 8 * j && MEM(b, cached(p))))
  && (
       ∀ j : Num,
         ∀ p : W32,
           j < 33
           && MEM(p, partial(j)) → MEM(p, ps)
           && sz(p) == 8 * j
           && 0 < tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
           && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p))))

entries.name: tlsf_small_backing
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_backing(
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (lim : Num)) == (
  ∀ p : W32,
    MEM(p, ps) → MEM(p, xs)
    && tlsf_used(hd(p))
    && tlsf_small_page_ok(
         lim,
         p,
         val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
         sz(p),
         loc(p),
         cached(p),
         live(p)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_count_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (b a : W32) (xs : List[W32]),
  tlsf_count(b, CONS(a, xs)) == (if a == b { 1 } else { 0 }) + tlsf_count(b, xs)

entries.name: tlsf_small_count_append
entries.statement:
∀ (b : W32) (xs ys : List[W32]),
  tlsf_count(b, APPEND(xs, ys)) == tlsf_count(b, xs) + tlsf_count(b, ys)

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition_checkout
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, CONS(b, cached), live)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, CONS(b, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition_release
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, CONS(b, live))
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), cached, live)

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition_export
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), NIL, live)
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, NIL, loc, CONS(b, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_accounting
entries.statement:
∀ (p : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
then
  tlsf_small_used(cached, live) <= tlsf_small_total(s)
  && (tlsf_small_used(cached, live) < tlsf_small_total(s)) == !(loc == NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_small_reclaimable
entries.statement:
∀ (cached live : List[W32]),
  (tlsf_small_used(cached, live) == 0) == (cached == NIL && live == NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_small_head
entries.statement: tlsf_small_head((xs : List[W32])) == (if xs == NIL { word(0) } else { HD(xs) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_links
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_links(NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_links(CONS((b : W32), (bs : List[W32]))) == star(
     pts(val(b) + 8, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(bs))),
     tlsf_small_links(bs))

entries.name: tlsf_small_partial_links
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_partial_links((prev : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) == star(
     pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(prev)),
     star(
       pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(ps))),
       tlsf_small_partial_links(p, ps)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot_heap
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_slot_heap((p : W32), (s : Num), (live : List[W32]), (i : Num)) == star(
  pts(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)), serialise_i32(word(4))),
  star(
    pts(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 4, serialise_i32(p)),
    star(
      if MEM(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i), live) { emp } else {
        tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 12, s - 4) },
      emp)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_page_heap
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_page_heap(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32])) == star(
  pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s))),
  star(
    pts(val(p) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total(s)))),
    star(
      pts(val(p) + 16, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_used(cached, live)))),
      star(
        pts(val(p) + 20, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(loc))),
        star(
          if tlsf_small_used(cached, live) < tlsf_small_total(s) { emp } else {
            tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8) },
          star(
            tlsf_istar(
              tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, live),
              tlsf_small_total(s)),
            star(
              tlsf_small_links(loc),
              star(
                tlsf_bytes(
                  val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s),
                  cap - 24 - (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s)),
                emp))))))))

entries.name: tlsf_small_pages_heap
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_pages_heap(
  NIL,
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]))
  == emp
&& tlsf_small_pages_heap(
     CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])),
     (hd : (W32) -> W32),
     (sz : (W32) -> Num),
     (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
     (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
     (live : (W32) -> List[W32])) == star(
     tlsf_small_page_heap(
       p,
       val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
       sz(p),
       loc(p),
       cached(p),
       live(p)),
     tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live))

entries.name: tlsf_small_table_item
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_table_item(
  (d : W32),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (j : Num)) == star(
  pts(
    val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912 + 8 * j,
    serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(fast(j)))),
  star(
    pts(
      val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1916 + 8 * j,
      serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(partial(j)))),
    star(
      tlsf_small_links(fast(j)),
      star(tlsf_small_partial_links(word(0), partial(j)), emp))))

entries.name: tlsf_small_table

tlsf_small_table(
  (d : W32),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]))

entries.name: tlsf_small
entries.statement:
tlsf_small(
  (d : W32),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    && star(
         tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live),
         tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial),
         h))

entries.name: tlsf_allocator

tlsf_allocator(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),

  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32])) == (
  (h : Heap) =>
    tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
    && star(
         tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl),

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots_member
entries.statement:
∀ (n s : Num) (p b : W32),
  MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n))
    == (∃ i : Num, i < n && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i))

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots_length
entries.statement: ∀ (n s : Num) (p : W32), LENGTH(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n)) == n

entries.name: tlsf_small_capacity
entries.statement:
∀ (s : Num)
if
  1. 8 <= s
  2. s <= 256
then
  4 <= tlsf_small_total(s)
  && tlsf_small_total(s) <= 66
  && (8 + s) * tlsf_small_total(s) <= 1056

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (lim cap s i : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) == val(p) + 32 + (8 + s) * i
  && val(p) + 32 <= val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i))
  && val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8 + s <= val(p) + 8 + cap
  && !(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot_injective
entries.statement:
∀ (lim cap s i j : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  3. j < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  (tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j)) == (i == j)

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots_disjoint
entries.statement:
∀ (lim cap s i j : Num) (p : W32) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < j
  3. j < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8 + s <= val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j))

entries.name: tlsf_small_partition_counts
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
then
  tlsf_count(b, loc) + tlsf_count(b, cached) + tlsf_count(b, live)
    == (if MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) { 1 } else { 0 })

entries.name: tlsf_small_slot_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (p : W32) (s i : Num) (loc cached live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, live)
  2. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
then
  tlsf_count(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i), loc) + tlsf_count(
    tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i),
    cached) + tlsf_count(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i), live)
    == 1

entries.name: tlsf_small_partial_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. 8 <= sz(p)
  4. sz(p) <= 256
  5. MOD(sz(p), 8) == 0
then
  MEM(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))
    == (tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p)))
  && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) → tlsf_count(
       p,
       partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))
       == 1

entries.name: tlsf_small_backing_used
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
then
  MEM(p, xs)
  && tlsf_used(hd(p))
  && 1080 <= val(tlsf_size(hd(p)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_cached_exact
entries.statement:
∀ (ps : List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (p b : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. MEM(b, cached(p))
then
  tlsf_count(b, fast(DIV(sz(p), 8))) == 1

entries.name: tlsf_small_pairwise_separate
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (R : (W32, W32) -> Bool) (p q : W32)
if
  1. PAIRWISE(R, xs)
  2. MEM(p, xs)
  3. MEM(q, xs)
  4. !(p == q)
then
  R(p, q)
or
  R(q, p)

entries.name: tlsf_small_backing_separate
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (prev top p q : W32) (a lim : Num)
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_layout(prev, a, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(q, ps)
  5. !(p == q)
then
  val(p) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(p))) <= val(q)
or
  val(q) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(q))) <= val(p)

entries.name: tlsf_small_live_owned

then

    pts(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 4, serialise_i32(p)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_page_slot_focus

entries.name: tlsf_allocator_frame

entries.name: tlsf_allocator_page_not_in_bins

∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim f j : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)

entries.name: tlsf_allocator_client_write
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl : W32) (lim a : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)

entries.name: tlsf_page_allocate_tail
entries.statement:
tlsf_page_allocate_tail((take_idx : Num)) ==
  local.tee 1
  i32.eqz
  if
    i32.const 0
    return
  end
  local.get 1
  i32.const 8
  i32.add
  local.get 0
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 12
  i32.add
  i32.const 1056
  local.get 0
  i32.const 8
  i32.add
  i32.div_u
  local.tee 5
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 28
  i32.add
  i32.const 0
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 32
  i32.add
  local.tee 2
  i32.const 8
  i32.add
  i32.const 0
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 2
  i32.const 4
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 2
  i32.const 4
  i32.add
  local.get 1
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  local.get 1
  i32.const 20
  i32.add
  local.get 2
  i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
  i32.const 1
  local.set 3
  loop
    block
      block (result i32)
        local.get 3
        local.get 5
        i32.lt_u
        if
          local.get 1
          i32.const 32
          i32.add
          local.get 3
          local.get 0
          i32.const 8
          i32.add
          i32.mul
          i32.add
          local.tee 4
          i32.const 4
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 4
          i32.const 4
          i32.add
          local.get 1
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 4
          i32.const 8
          i32.add
          local.get 2
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 1
          i32.const 20
          i32.add
          local.get 4
          i32.store offset=0 align=2**2
          local.get 4
          local.set 2
          local.get 3
          i32.const 1
          i32.add
          br 1
        end
        br 1
      end
      local.set 3
      br 1
    end
  end
  local.get 1

entries.name: tlsf_small_put
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_put((ff : (W32) -> List[W32]), (p : W32), (vs : List[W32]))
  == ((q : W32) => if q == p { vs } else { ff(q) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_put_class
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_put_class((ff : (Num) -> List[W32]), (j : Num), (vs : List[W32]))
  == ((k : Num) => if k == j { vs } else { ff(k) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_remove
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_remove((p : W32), (xs : List[W32]))
  == FILTER((q : W32) => !(q == p), xs)

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_loc
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_free_loc((loc : (W32) -> List[W32]), (p : W32), (b : W32))
  == tlsf_small_put(loc, p, CONS(b, loc(p)))

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_live
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_free_live((live : (W32) -> List[W32]), (p : W32), (b : W32))
  == tlsf_small_put(live, p, tlsf_small_remove(b, live(p)))

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_partial
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_free_partial(
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (p : W32)) == (
  if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) {
    tlsf_small_put_class(
      partial,
      DIV(sz(p), 8),
      CONS(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))) } else {
    if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == 1 {
      tlsf_small_put_class(
        partial,
        DIV(sz(p), 8),
        tlsf_small_remove(p, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)))) } else { partial } })

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_pages
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_free_pages(
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (p : W32)) == (
  if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
    == 1 { tlsf_small_remove(p, ps) } else { ps })

entries.name: tlsf_small_remove_member
entries.statement:
∀ (p q : W32) (xs : List[W32]),
  MEM(q, tlsf_small_remove(p, xs)) == (MEM(q, xs) && !(q == p))

entries.name: tlsf_small_remove_nil
entries.statement: ∀ (p : W32), tlsf_small_remove(p, NIL) == NIL

entries.name: tlsf_small_remove_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (p h : W32) (t : List[W32]),
  tlsf_small_remove(p, CONS(h, t)) == (
    if h == p { tlsf_small_remove(p, t) } else {
      CONS(h, tlsf_small_remove(p, t)) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_remove_absent
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. !MEM(p, xs)
then
  tlsf_small_remove(p, xs) == xs

entries.name: tlsf_small_remove_split
entries.statement:
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. !MEM(p, a)
  2. !MEM(p, z)
then
  tlsf_small_remove(p, APPEND(a, CONS(p, z))) == APPEND(a, z)

entries.name: tlsf_small_count_one_split
entries.statement:
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_count(p, APPEND(a, CONS(p, z))) == 1
then
  !MEM(p, a)
  && !MEM(p, z)

entries.name: tlsf_small_release_partition
entries.statement:
∀ (p b : W32) (s : Num) (loc cached a z : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_partition(p, s, loc, cached, APPEND(a, CONS(b, z)))
then
  tlsf_small_partition(p, s, CONS(b, loc), cached, APPEND(a, z))

entries.name: tlsf_small_release_used
entries.statement:
∀ (cached a z : List[W32]) (b : W32),
  tlsf_small_used(cached, APPEND(a, CONS(b, z)))
    == SUC(tlsf_small_used(cached, APPEND(a, z)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_last_live
entries.statement:
∀ (cached a z : List[W32]) (b : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_used(cached, APPEND(a, CONS(b, z))) == 1
then
  cached == NIL
  && a == NIL
  && z == NIL

entries.name: tlsf_small_remove_count
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (p q : W32),
  tlsf_count(q, tlsf_small_remove(p, xs))
    == (if q == p { 0 } else { tlsf_count(q, xs) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_member_split
entries.statement:
∀ (p : W32) (xs : List[W32])
if
  1. MEM(p, xs)
then
  ∃ (a z : List[W32]), xs == APPEND(a, CONS(p, z))

entries.name: tlsf_small_hlist
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_hlist((ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool), NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_hlist(
     (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool),
     CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])))
     == star(ff(p), tlsf_small_hlist(ff, ps))

entries.name: tlsf_small_hlist_append
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ys : List[W32]) (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool),
  tlsf_small_hlist(ff, APPEND(xs, ys))
    == star(tlsf_small_hlist(ff, xs), tlsf_small_hlist(ff, ys))

entries.name: tlsf_small_hlist_cong
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (ff gg : (W32, Heap) -> Bool)
if
  1. ∀ p : W32, MEM(p, xs) → ff(p) == gg(p)
then
  tlsf_small_hlist(ff, xs) == tlsf_small_hlist(gg, xs)

entries.name: tlsf_small_hlist_focus
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (ff : (W32, Heap) -> Bool) (p : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_count(p, xs) == 1
then
  tlsf_small_hlist(ff, xs)
    == star(ff(p), tlsf_small_hlist(ff, tlsf_small_remove(p, xs)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_dlist
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_dlist((pr : W32), NIL, (nx : W32)) == emp
&& tlsf_small_dlist((pr : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])), (nx : W32)) == star(
     pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(pr)),
     star(
       pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(if ps == NIL { nx } else { HD(ps) })),
       tlsf_small_dlist(p, ps, nx)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_last
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_last((fallback : W32), (xs : List[W32]))
  == (if xs == NIL { fallback } else { LAST(xs) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_first
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_first((xs : List[W32]), (fallback : W32))
  == (if xs == NIL { fallback } else { HD(xs) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_dtail
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_dtail((pr : W32), NIL) == emp
&& tlsf_small_dtail((pr : W32), CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32]))) == star(
     pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(pr)),
     if ps == NIL { emp } else {
       star(pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(HD(ps))), tlsf_small_dtail(p, ps)) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_partial_dlist
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (pr : W32),
  tlsf_small_partial_links(pr, xs) == tlsf_small_dlist(pr, xs, word(0))

entries.name: tlsf_small_first_append
entries.statement:
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (nx : W32),
  tlsf_small_first(APPEND(a, z), nx)
    == tlsf_small_first(a, tlsf_small_first(z, nx))

entries.name: tlsf_small_last_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (p h : W32) (t : List[W32]),
  tlsf_small_last(p, CONS(h, t)) == tlsf_small_last(h, t)

entries.name: tlsf_small_dlist_cons
entries.statement:
∀ (pr p nx : W32) (ps : List[W32]),
  tlsf_small_dlist(pr, CONS(p, ps), nx) == star(
    pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(pr)),
    star(
      pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_first(ps, nx))),
      tlsf_small_dlist(p, ps, nx)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_dlist_nil
entries.statement: ∀ (pr nx : W32), tlsf_small_dlist(pr, NIL, nx) == emp

entries.name: tlsf_small_last_nil
entries.statement: ∀ (p : W32), tlsf_small_last(p, NIL) == p

entries.name: tlsf_small_dlist_append
entries.statement:
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (pr nx : W32),
  tlsf_small_dlist(pr, APPEND(a, z), nx) == star(
    tlsf_small_dlist(pr, a, tlsf_small_first(z, nx)),
    tlsf_small_dlist(tlsf_small_last(pr, a), z, nx))

entries.name: tlsf_small_dlist_tail
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (pr nx : W32),
  tlsf_small_dlist(pr, xs, nx) == star(
    tlsf_small_dtail(pr, xs),
    if xs == NIL { emp } else {
      pts(val(tlsf_small_last(pr, xs)) + 28, serialise_i32(nx)) })

entries.name: tlsf_small_dhead
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_dhead(NIL, (nx : W32)) == emp
&& tlsf_small_dhead(CONS((p : W32), (ps : List[W32])), (nx : W32)) == star(
     pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_first(ps, nx))),
     tlsf_small_dlist(p, ps, nx))

entries.name: tlsf_small_dlist_head
entries.statement:
∀ (xs : List[W32]) (pr nx : W32),
  tlsf_small_dlist(pr, xs, nx) == star(
    if xs == NIL { emp } else { pts(val(HD(xs)) + 24, serialise_i32(pr)) },
    tlsf_small_dhead(xs, nx))

entries.name: tlsf_small_dlist_unlink_view
entries.statement:
∀ (a z : List[W32]) (prev next p : W32),
  tlsf_small_dlist(prev, APPEND(a, CONS(p, z)), next) == star(
    tlsf_small_dtail(prev, a),
    star(
      if a == NIL { emp } else {
        pts(val(tlsf_small_last(prev, a)) + 28, serialise_i32(p)) },
      star(
        pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_last(prev, a))),
        star(
          pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_first(z, next))),

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_unlink_prev_nil_table
entries.statement:
∀ (d p nx : W32) (free_idx s : Num) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (a tail : List[W32]) (u l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. 8 <= s
  3. s <= 256
  4. MOD(s, 8) == 0
  5. val(p) + 32 <= 4294967296
  6. partial(DIV(s, 8)) == APPEND(a, [p])
  7. !(a == NIL)
  8. !(tlsf_small_last(word(0), a) == word(0))
  9. val(tlsf_small_last(word(0), a)) + 32 <= 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s))),
          star(tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial), star(fp(gs, ms), emp)))),
    tlsf_block_free_unlink(d, free_idx),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_last(word(0), a)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s))),
          star(
            tlsf_small_table(
              d,
              fast,
              tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(s, 8), APPEND(a, NIL))),
            star(
              pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(tlsf_small_last(word(0), a))),
              star(
                pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(word(0))),
                star(fp(gs, ms), emp)))))))

  && tlsf_small_total(sz(p)) <= 66
  && tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))
       == SUC(tlsf_small_used(cached(p), tlsf_small_remove(b, live(p))))

entries.name: tlsf_small_slots_counts

if

         i < n
         && j < n
         && tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i) == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, j) → i == j

    == (if MEM(b, tlsf_small_slots(p, s, n)) { 1 } else { 0 })

  2. tlsf_istar(ff, n, h)
then

if
  1. 8 <= s
  2. star(
       tlsf_small_slot_heap(p, s, NIL, i),
       star(tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)) + 8, 4), R),
       h)
then
  star(tlsf_bytes(val(tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)), 8 + s), R, h)

entries.name: tlsf_small_words6
entries.statement:
∀ (a len : Num)
if
  1. 24 <= len
then
  tlsf_bytes(a, len) == (
    (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ w0 : W32,
        ∃ w1 : W32,
          ∃ w2 : W32,
            ∃ w3 : W32,
              ∃ w4 : W32,
                ∃ w5 : W32,
                  star(
                    pts(a + 0, serialise_i32(w0)),
                    star(
                      pts(a + 4, serialise_i32(w1)),
                      star(
                        pts(a + 8, serialise_i32(w2)),
                        star(
                          pts(a + 12, serialise_i32(w3)),
                          star(
                            pts(a + 16, serialise_i32(w4)),
                            star(
                              pts(a + 20, serialise_i32(w5)),
                              star(tlsf_bytes(a + 24, len - 24), emp)))))),
                    h))

entries.name: tlsf_small_recover_page
entries.statement:
∀ (lim cap s : Num) (p prev next : W32) (loc : List[W32]) (R : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, loc, NIL, NIL)
  2. star(
       tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, loc, NIL, NIL),
       star(
         pts(val(p) + 24, serialise_i32(prev)),
         star(pts(val(p) + 28, serialise_i32(next)), R)),
       h)
then
  star(tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 8, cap), R, h)

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_release_frame
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_free_release_frame(
  (p : W32),
  (cap : Num),
  (s : Num),
  (loc : List[W32]),
  (cached : List[W32]),
  (live : List[W32]),
  (b : W32),
  (i : Num)) == star(
  pts(val(p) + 8, serialise_i32(word(s))),
  star(
    pts(val(p) + 12, serialise_i32(word(tlsf_small_total(s)))),
    star(
      pts(val(b), serialise_i32(word(4))),
      star(

if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(b, live(p))
  5. i < tlsf_small_total(sz(p))
  6. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, sz(p), i)
then

    st(
      NIL,
      [l0, V_num(ConstInt32(b)), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live),
          star(
            tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial),
            star(tlsf_bytes(val(b) + 8, sz(p)), star(fp(gs, ms), emp))))),
    tlsf_block_free_release(d, free_idx),

            tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial),
            star(

              star(fp(gs, ms), emp))))))

  4. val(d) <= 4294965088

       MEM(q, partial(DIV(sz(p), 8))) → !(q == word(0))
       && val(q) + 32 <= 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],

entries.name: tlsf_small_free_backing
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (m : W32)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, xs)
       && !(x == m)
       && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2)
       && hd2(x) == hd(x)
then
  tlsf_small_backing(xs2, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)

entries.name: tlsf_small_free_heap
entries.statement:
∀ (xs ps xs2 : List[W32]) (hd hd2 : (W32) -> W32) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (lim : Num) (m d : W32)
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. ∀ x : W32,
       MEM(x, xs)
       && !(x == m)
       && tlsf_used(hd(x)) → MEM(x, xs2)
       && hd2(x) == hd(x)
then
  tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
    == tlsf_small(d, hd2, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)

entries.name: tlsf_small_return_post
entries.statement:
tlsf_small_return_post(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (m : W32),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    res == [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))]
    && ms == lim
    && (
         ∃ top2 : W32,
           ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
             ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl2 : W32,
                 ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                   ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                     star(
                       tlsf_allocator(
                         d,
                         lim,
                         top2,
                         xs2,
                         hd2,
                         fl2,
                         sb2,
                         bl2,
                         ps,
                         sz,
                         loc,
                         cached,
                         live,
                         fast,
                         partial),
                       fp(gs, ms),
                       h)))

entries.name: tlsf_small_return_post_fold
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl m : W32) (lim ms : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (res gs : List[Value]) (h : Heap)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. tlsf_free_post(
       d,
       m,
       lim,
       top,
       xs,
       hd,
       fl,
       sb,
       bl,
       (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
         star(
           tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial),
           fp(gs, ms)),
       res,
       gs,
       ms,
       h)
then
  tlsf_small_return_post(
    d,
    lim,
    top,
    xs,
    hd,
    fl,
    sb,
    bl,
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,
    cached,
    live,
    fast,
    partial,
    m,
    fp,
    res,
    gs,
    ms,
    h)

entries.name: tlsf_small_return_all
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (pop push free_idx lim : Num)
  (d top fl m : W32) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. !MEM(m, ps)
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_free_pre(
             d,
             m,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
               star(
                 tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial),
                 fp(gs, ms)),
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(free_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_small_return_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,
             m,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_small_backing_remove_domain
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
then
  tlsf_small_backing(
    xs,
    hd,
    tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
    sz,
    loc,
    cached,
    live,
    lim)

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_reclaim_head_nil_all
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p nx : W32)
  (xs ps a tail : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (u l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  4. cached(p) == NIL
  5. live(p) == NIL
  6. val(d) <= 4294965088
  7. partial(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == APPEND(NIL, [p])
  8. tlsf_small_lists_ok(
       tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
       sz,
       loc,
       cached,
       live,
       fast,
       tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(sz(p), 8), APPEND(NIL, NIL)))
  9. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  10. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
        inst,
        Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
        [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
        tlsf_pop_code(d))
  11. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
        inst,
        Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
        [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
        tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), u, l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && star(
             tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
             star(
               tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live),
               star(
                 tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial),
                 star(fp(gs, ms), emp))),
             h)),
    tlsf_block_free_reclaim(d, free_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(NIL, res)
        && lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(0))),
            V_num(ConstInt32(word(DIV(sz(p), 8))))]
        && tlsf_small_return_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             tlsf_small_remove(p, ps),
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             tlsf_small_put_class(partial, DIV(sz(p), 8), APPEND(NIL, NIL)),
             p,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    labels)

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_pre
entries.statement:
tlsf_block_free_pre(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (p : W32),
  (b : W32),
  (l0 : Value),
  (l2 : Value),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
  (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    vs == NIL
    && lc == [l0, V_num(ConstInt32(b)), l2]
    && ms == lim
    && MEM(p, ps)
    && MEM(b, live(p))
    && star(
         tlsf_allocator(
           d,
           lim,
           top,
           xs,
           hd,
           fl,
           sb,
           bl,
           ps,
           sz,
           loc,
           cached,

entries.name: tlsf_block_free_tail_full
entries.statement:
∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (rp : SAssn)
  (labels : List[SAssn]) (pop push free_idx lim : Num) (d top fl p b : W32)
  (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32)
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (l0 l2 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. MEM(p, ps)
  4. MEM(b, live(p))
  5. val(d) <= 4294965088
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, free_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_free_code(d, pop, push))
  7. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  8. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
  9. tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) == tlsf_small_total(sz(p))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    rp,
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p))))), l2],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(
            ps,
            hd,
            sz,
            tlsf_block_free_loc(loc, p, b),
            cached,
            tlsf_block_free_live(live, p, b)),
          star(
            tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial),
            star(
              if tlsf_small_used(cached(p), live(p)) < tlsf_small_total(
                sz(p)) { emp } else { tlsf_bytes(val(p) + 24, 8) },
              star(
                (
                  (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
                    ms == lim
                    && star(
                         tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
                         fp(gs, ms),
                         h))(gs, ms),
                emp))))),
    tlsf_block_free_tail(d, free_idx),
    tlsf_block_free_post(
      d,
      lim,
      top,
      xs,
      hd,
      fl,
      sb,
      bl,
      ps,
      sz,
      loc,
      cached,
      live,
      fast,
      partial,
      p,
      b,
      l0,
      l2,
      fp),
    labels)

  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. ∀ q : W32, MEM(q, ps) → DIV(sz(q), 8) < 33
  3. ∀ q : W32,
       !(q == p) → MEM(q, ps2) == MEM(q, ps)
       && tlsf_count(q, ps2) == tlsf_count(q, ps)
       && sz2(q) == sz(q)
       && cached2(q) == cached(q)
       && live2(q) == live(q)
  4. MEM(p, ps2)
  5. tlsf_count(p, ps2) == 1
  6. sz2(p) == s
  7. cached2(p) == bs
  8. tlsf_small_used(cached2(p), live2(p)) == tlsf_small_total(s)
  9. 0 < tlsf_small_total(s)
  10. s == 8 * k
  11. k < 33
  12. !MEM(p, ps) || cached(p) == NIL
  13. fast(k) == NIL
  14. fast2 == tlsf_small_put_class(fast, k, bs)
  15. ∀ b : W32, MEM(b, bs) → tlsf_count(b, bs) == 1
  16. ∀ j : Num, j < 33 → partial2(j) == tlsf_small_remove(p, partial(j))

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_partial_address
entries.statement:
∀ (d : W32) (s : Num)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. s <= 256
then
  val(
    word_add(
      word_add(word(s), word_and(word_add(d, word(15)), word(4294967280))),
      word(1916)))
    == val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1916 + s

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_fresh_page
entries.statement:
∀ (d p b used0 prev0 : W32) (lim cap s i : Num) (bs live : List[W32])
  (l1 l3 l4 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, live)
  3. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  4. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  5. live == NIL
  6. REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(b)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(p, word(20)))), l4],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          tlsf_page_allocate_build(
            p,
            cap,
            s,
            tlsf_small_total(s),
            used0,
            prev0),
          star(
            pts(val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912 + s, serialise_i32(word(0))),
            star(fp(gs, ms), emp)))),
    tlsf_page_publish_fresh_code(d),
    st(
      [V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(b, word(8))))],
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(b, word(8)))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(p, word(20)))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(bs)))],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          star(
            tlsf_small_page_heap(p, cap, s, NIL, bs, CONS(b, live)),
            star(tlsf_small_links(bs), tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, s))),
          star(
            pts(
              val(tlsf_base(d)) + 1912 + s,
              serialise_i32(tlsf_small_head(bs))),
            star(fp(gs, ms), emp)))))

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_fresh_small
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p b used0 prev0 : W32) (lim s i : Num) (xs ps bs z : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l3 l4 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))), s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, NIL)
  3. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  4. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  5. fast(DIV(s, 8)) == NIL
  6. !MEM(p, ps)
  7. REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(b)), V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(p, word(20)))), l4],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          tlsf_page_allocate_build(
            p,
            val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
            s,
            tlsf_small_total(s),
            used0,
            prev0),
          star(
            tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live),
            star(tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial), star(fp(gs, ms), emp))))),
    tlsf_page_publish_fresh_code(d),
    (res : List[Value]) => (lc2 : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc2 == [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(b, word(8)))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(p, word(20)))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(bs)))]
      && res == [V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(b, word(8))))]
      && (
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
             star(
               tlsf_small_pages_heap(
                 CONS(p, ps),
                 hd,
                 (q : W32) => if q == p { s } else { sz(q) },
                 tlsf_small_put(loc, p, NIL),
                 tlsf_small_put(cached, p, bs),
                 tlsf_small_put(live, p, [b])),
               star(
                 tlsf_small_table(
                   d,
                   tlsf_small_put_class(fast, DIV(s, 8), bs),
                   partial),
                 star(
                   tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, s),
                   star(fp(gs, ms), emp)))))(gs, ms, h))

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_partial_small
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p b used0 prev0 : W32) (lim s i : Num) (xs ps bs z : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l3 l4 : Value) (fp : GProp)
if
  1. val(d) <= 4294965088
  2. tlsf_small_page_ok(
       lim,
       p,
       val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
       s,
       CONS(b, bs),
       NIL,
       live(p))
  3. i < tlsf_small_total(s)
  4. b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
  5. fast(DIV(s, 8)) == NIL
  6. tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
  7. sz(p) == s
  8. loc(p) == CONS(b, bs)
  9. cached(p) == NIL
  10. partial(DIV(s, 8)) == CONS(p, z)
  11. ∀ q : W32, MEM(q, z) → !(q == word(0)) && val(q) + 32 <= 4294967296
then
  sl_triple(
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), l1, V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), l3, l4],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
        star(
          tlsf_small_pages_heap(ps, hd, sz, loc, cached, live),
          star(tlsf_small_table(d, fast, partial), star(fp(gs, ms), emp)))),
    tlsf_page_publish_partial_code(d),
    (res : List[Value]) => (lc2 : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      lc2 == [V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(z))), V_num(ConstInt32(b)),
       V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(p, word(20)))),
       V_num(ConstInt32(tlsf_small_head(bs)))]
      && res == [V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(b, word(8))))]
      && (
           (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) =>
             star(
               tlsf_small_pages_heap(
                 ps,
                 hd,
                 sz,
                 tlsf_small_put(loc, p, NIL),
                 tlsf_small_put(cached, p, bs),
                 tlsf_small_put(live, p, CONS(b, live(p)))),
               star(
                 tlsf_small_table(
                   d,
                   tlsf_small_put_class(fast, DIV(s, 8), bs),
                   tlsf_small_put_class(
                     partial,
                     DIV(s, 8),
                     TL(partial(DIV(s, 8))))),
                 star(
                   tlsf_page_publish_payload(b, s),
                   star(fp(gs, ms), emp)))))(gs, ms, h))

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_large_bounds
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (client : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. star(tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl), client, h)
  2. MEM(p, xs)
then
  val(d) <= 4294965088
  && lim <= 4294967296
  && val(p) + 8 + val(tlsf_size(hd(p))) <= lim

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_local_index
entries.statement:
∀ (lim cap s : Num) (p b : W32) (bs live : List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_page_ok(lim, p, cap, s, CONS(b, bs), NIL, live)
then
  ∃ (i : Num),
    i < tlsf_small_total(s)
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_empty_cached
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  2. MEM(p, ps)
  3. fast(DIV(sz(p), 8)) == NIL
then
  cached(p) == NIL

entries.name: tlsf_page_publish_allocated_ready
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim s : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (client : HProp) (h : Heap)
if
  1. star(
       tlsf_allocator(
         d,
         lim,
         top,
         xs,
         hd,
         fl,
         sb,
         bl,
         ps,
         sz,
         loc,
         cached,
         live,
         fast,
         partial),
       star(tlsf_page_allocate_fresh(p, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))), s), client),
       h)
  2. MEM(p, xs)
then
  tlsf_small_page_ok(
    lim,
    p,
    val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
    s,
    REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))),
    NIL,
    NIL)

  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (l1 l3 l4 : Value) (fp : GProp),

    top,
    xs,

    fl,
    sb,
    bl,
    ps,
    sz,
    loc,

    fast,
    partial,
    p,
    b,
    bs,
    s,
    used0,
    prev0,
    l1,
    l3,
    l4,
    fp,
    z) == (
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      vs == NIL
      && lc == [V_num(ConstInt32(p)), V_num(ConstInt32(b)),
          V_num(ConstInt32(word(s))), V_num(ConstInt32(word_add(p, word(20)))),
          l4]
      && ms == lim
      && !MEM(p, ps)
      && MEM(p, xs)
      && tlsf_used(hd(p))
      && tlsf_small_page_ok(
           lim,
           p,
           val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
           s,
           CONS(b, bs),
           NIL,
           NIL)
      && REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
      && fast(DIV(s, 8)) == NIL
      && star(
           tlsf_allocator(

             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,

entries.name: tlsf_malloc_cached_dispatch
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl b : W32) (lim k : Num) (xs ps bs : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. k < 33
  4. fast(k) == CONS(b, bs)
then
  ∃ (p : W32) (i : Num),
    tlsf_small_page_ok(
      lim,
      p,
      val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
      8 * k,
      loc(p),
      cached(p),
      live(p))
    && MEM(p, ps)
    && MEM(b, cached(p))
    && sz(p) == 8 * k
    && tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
    && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * k)
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * k, i)

entries.name: tlsf_malloc_partial_dispatch
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim k : Num) (xs ps z : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. tlsf_small_lists_ok(ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial)
  3. k < 33
  4. fast(k) == NIL
  5. partial(k) == CONS(p, z)
then
  ∃ (b : W32) (bs : List[W32]) (i : Num),
    tlsf_small_page_ok(
      lim,
      p,
      val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
      8 * k,
      CONS(b, bs),
      NIL,
      live(p))
    && MEM(p, ps)
    && sz(p) == 8 * k
    && loc(p) == CONS(b, bs)
    && cached(p) == NIL
    && tlsf_count(p, ps) == 1
    && i < tlsf_small_total(8 * k)
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, 8 * k, i)
    && ∀ q : W32, MEM(q, z) → !(q == word(0)) && val(q) + 32 <= 4294967296

entries.name: tlsf_malloc_fresh_dispatch
entries.statement:
∀ (d top fl p : W32) (lim s : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
if
  1. tlsf_physical_ok(d, lim, top, xs, hd)
  2. MEM(p, xs)
  3. tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(p, val(tlsf_size(hd(p))), s)
then
  ∃ (b : W32) (bs : List[W32]) (i : Num),
    REVERSE(tlsf_small_slots(p, s, tlsf_small_total(s))) == CONS(b, bs)
    && tlsf_small_page_ok(
         lim,
         p,
         val(tlsf_size(hd(p))),
         s,
         CONS(b, bs),
         NIL,
         NIL)
    && i < tlsf_small_total(s)
    && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, s, i)
    && !(b == word(0))

∀ (G : Specs) (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst)
  (pop push take_idx lim : Num) (d top fl s : W32) (xs ps : List[W32])
  (hd : (W32) -> W32) (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32])
  (sz : (W32) -> Num) (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32])
  (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32]) (before : Heap) (fp : GProp)
  (l1 l2 l3 l4 l5 : Value)
if
  1. tlsf_small_backing(xs, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, lim)
  2. 8 <= val(s)
  3. val(s) <= 256
  4. MOD(val(s), 8) == 0
  5. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  6. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  7. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_g(
    G,
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_malloc_page_post(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,
        partial,
        s,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    st(
      NIL,
      [V_num(ConstInt32(s)), l1, l2, l3, l4, l5],
      (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        ms == lim
        && h == before
        && star(
             tlsf_large(d, lim, top, xs, hd, fl, sb, bl),
             star(
               tlsf_small(d, hd, ps, sz, loc, cached, live, fast, partial),
               fp(gs, ms)),
             h)),
    tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx),
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      tlsf_malloc_page_post(
        d,
        lim,
        top,
        xs,
        hd,
        fl,
        sb,
        bl,
        ps,
        sz,
        loc,
        cached,
        live,
        fast,
        partial,
        s,
        before,
        fp,
        vs,
        gs,
        ms,
        h),
    [
      (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
      (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
        tlsf_malloc_page_post(
          d,
          lim,
          top,
          xs,
          hd,
          fl,
          sb,
          bl,
          ps,
          sz,
          loc,
          cached,
          live,
          fast,
          partial,
          s,
          before,
          fp,
          vs,
          gs,
          ms,
          h)])

  a == sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx)
  && (
       ∃ lim : Num,
         ∃ top : W32,
           ∃ xs : List[W32],
             ∃ hd : (W32) -> W32,
               ∃ fl : W32,
                 ∃ sb : (Num) -> W32,

                             ∃ live : (W32) -> List[W32],
                               ∃ fast : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                 ∃ partial : (Num) -> List[W32],
                                   ∃ s : W32,
                                     ∃ before : Heap,
                                       ∃ fp : GProp,
                                         P == tlsf_malloc_page_pre(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top,
                                           xs,
                                           hd,

                                           ps,

                                           live,

                                              bl,
                                              ps,

entries.name: tlsf_malloc_page_specs
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d : W32)
  (pop push take_idx page_idx k : Num)
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  specs_ok(
    k,
    tlsf_malloc_page_spec(inst, d, take_idx, page_idx),
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst)

entries.name: tlsf_malloc_page_all
entries.statement:
∀ (fs : List[Cl]) (tabs : Tabs) (inst : Inst) (d top fl s : W32)
  (pop push take_idx page_idx lim : Num) (xs ps : List[W32]) (hd : (W32) -> W32)
  (sb : (Num) -> W32) (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]) (sz : (W32) -> Num)
  (loc cached live : (W32) -> List[W32]) (fast partial : (Num) -> List[W32])
  (before : Heap) (fp : GProp) (vs0 lc0 : List[Value])
if
  1. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, page_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_page_allocate_code(take_idx))
  2. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, take_idx), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_take_code(d, pop, push))
  3. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, pop), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], NIL),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_pop_code(d))
  4. EL(sfunc_ind(inst, push), fs) == Func_native(
       inst,
       Tf([T_num(T_i32)], [T_num(T_i32)]),
       [T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32), T_num(T_i32)],
       tlsf_push_code(d))
then
  sl_triple_m(
    fs,
    tabs,
    inst,
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ args : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, args)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_malloc_page_pre(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,
             s,
             before,
             fp,
             args,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    [Call(page_idx)],
    (vs : List[Value]) => (lc : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) =>
    (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
      ∃ res : List[Value],
        vs == APPEND(vs0, res)
        && lc == lc0
        && tlsf_malloc_page_post(
             d,
             lim,
             top,
             xs,
             hd,
             fl,
             sb,
             bl,
             ps,
             sz,
             loc,
             cached,
             live,
             fast,
             partial,
             s,
             before,
             fp,
             res,
             gs,
             ms,
             h),
    NIL)

entries.name: tlsf_malloc_page_ready_post
entries.statement:
tlsf_malloc_page_ready_post(
  (d : W32),
  (lim : Num),
  (top : W32),
  (xs : List[W32]),
  (hd : (W32) -> W32),
  (fl : W32),
  (sb : (Num) -> W32),
  (bl : (Num, Num) -> List[W32]),
  (ps : List[W32]),
  (sz : (W32) -> Num),
  (loc : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (cached : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (live : (W32) -> List[W32]),
  (fast : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (partial : (Num) -> List[W32]),
  (s : W32),
  (before : Heap),
  (fp : GProp)) == (
  (res : List[Value]) => (gs : List[Value]) => (ms : Num) => (h : Heap) =>
    ms == lim
    && (
         res == [V_num(ConstInt32(word(0)))]
         && tlsf_search(word(1080), fl, sb, bl) == word(0)
         && h == before
         && star(
              tlsf_allocator(
                d,
                lim,
                top,
                xs,
                hd,
                fl,
                sb,
                bl,
                ps,
                sz,
                loc,
                cached,
                live,
                fast,
                partial),
              fp(gs, ms),
              h)
         || (
              ∃ p : W32,
                ∃ top2 : W32,
                  ∃ xs2 : List[W32],
                    ∃ hd2 : (W32) -> W32,
                      ∃ fl2 : W32,
                        ∃ sb2 : (Num) -> W32,
                          ∃ bl2 : (Num, Num) -> List[W32],
                            ∃ used0 : W32,
                              ∃ prev0 : W32,
                                ∃ b : W32,
                                  ∃ bs : List[W32],
                                    ∃ i : Num,
                                      res == [V_num(ConstInt32(p))]
                                      && !(
                                           tlsf_search(
                                             word(1080),
                                             fl,
                                             sb,
                                             bl)
                                             == word(0))
                                      && !(p == word(0))
                                      && !MEM(p, ps)
                                      && MEM(p, xs2)
                                      && tlsf_used(hd2(p))
                                      && tlsf_physical_ok(
                                           d,
                                           lim,
                                           top2,
                                           xs2,
                                           hd2)
                                      && tlsf_small_backing(
                                           xs2,
                                           hd2,
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           lim)
                                      && tlsf_small_lists_ok(
                                           ps,
                                           sz,
                                           loc,
                                           cached,
                                           live,
                                           fast,
                                           partial)
                                      && tlsf_page_allocate_geometry(
                                           p,
                                           val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                           val(s))
                                      && REVERSE(
                                           tlsf_small_slots(
                                             p,
                                             val(s),
                                             tlsf_small_total(val(s))))
                                           == CONS(b, bs)
                                      && tlsf_small_page_ok(
                                           lim,
                                           p,
                                           val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                           val(s),
                                           CONS(b, bs),
                                           NIL,
                                           NIL)
                                      && i < tlsf_small_total(val(s))
                                      && b == tlsf_small_slot(p, val(s), i)
                                      && !(b == word(0))
                                      && star(
                                           tlsf_page_allocate_build(
                                             p,
                                             val(tlsf_size(hd2(p))),
                                             val(s),
                                             tlsf_small_total(val(s)),
                                             used0,
                                             prev0),
                                           star(
                                             tlsf_allocator(
                                               d,
                                               lim,
                                               top2,
                                               xs2,
                                               hd2,
                                               fl2,
                                               sb2,
                                               bl2,
                                               ps,
                                               sz,
                                               loc,
                                               cached,
                                               live,
                                               fast,
                                               partial),
                                             star(fp(gs, ms), emp)),
                                           h))))
